FishFCommon.name: Moper
FishFCommon.description: Common docile denizen of the River Cocytus.

FishFCommon_Flavor.description: Technically a living creature, symbiotic with the souls of things residing in nearby waters.

FishFRare.name: Figment
FishFRare.description: Uncommon ephemeral denizen of the River Cocytus.

FishFRare_Flavor.description: So keen on being a fish during its mortal coil that it retains a similar form even now.

FishFLegendary.name: Soulbelly
FishFLegendary.description: Elusive large predatory denizen seldom seen in the River Cocytus.

FishFLegendary_Flavor.description: Devours the souls of aquatic life, but only for sport, as they can simply leave once ingested.

FishGCommon.name: Chiton
FishGCommon.description: Common armored denizen lurking in briny depths.

FishGCommon_Flavor.description: Its armored plating resembles that of mortal warriors, perhaps not by coincidence entirely.

FishGRare.name: Gutterpop
FishGRare.description: Uncommon boneless denizen accustomed to briny depths.

FishGRare_Flavor.description: Lives far below the surface yet paradoxically prefers the shallows, to practice walking.

FishGLegendary.name: Stalkfin
FishGLegendary.description: Elusive deep-sea denizen seldom seen even in briny depths.

FishGLegendary_Flavor.description: The protrusion on its head generates a bit of light, but it prefers total darkness.

FishHCommon.name: Soby
FishHCommon.description: Common skittish denizen from lakes deep in the Earth.

FishHCommon_Flavor.description: Though craven in appearance, it is thought to have braved the journey from the surface.

FishHRare.name: Anguish
FishHRare.description: Uncommon awkward denizen from lakes deep in the Earth.

FishHRare_Flavor.description: It filters water through glands near its eyes, making it appear sad at all times.

FishHLegendary.name: Tearjerker
FishHLegendary.description: Elusive solitary denizen seldom seen in lakes deep in the Earth.

FishHLegendary_Flavor.description: A non-aggressive variety of Hippocampus whose foremost want is to be left alone.

FishICommon.name: Jiffy
FishICommon.description: Common toothy denizen of the Sands of Chrysos.

FishICommon_Flavor.description: Its brittle glassy body can shatter against hard surfaces, but then regenerates.

FishIRare.name: Goldfish
FishIRare.description: Uncommon graceful denizen of the Sands of Chrysos.

FishIRare_Flavor.description: Distinct from the common surface variety, it is almost invisible within its habitat.

FishILegendary.name: Styxeon
FishILegendary.description: Elusive ancient denizen seldom seen in the Sands of Chrysos.

FishILegendary_Flavor.description: Originally from the River Styx, it stubbornly remained after its entire habitat changed.

FishNCommon.name: Ribeye
FishNCommon.description: Common deathless denizen from the River Acheron.

FishNCommon_Flavor.description: Easily mistaken for the skeleton of a fish, but this turns out to be a clever defense.

FishNRare.name: Zeel
FishNRare.description: Uncommon serpentine denizen from the River Acheron.

FishNRare_Flavor.description: Whether it is technically a fish or not has lately ceased to be a subject of debate.

FishNLegendary.name: Neckbiter
FishNLegendary.description: Elusive vicious predatory denizen seldom seen in the River Acheron.

FishNLegendary_Flavor.description: Never once caught except by its own choice, likely to get closer to more unusual meals.

FishOCommon.name: Shrimp
FishOCommon.description: Common placid denizen that masses near shipwrecks.

FishOCommon_Flavor.description: Untold numbers of these flowed from the sea into the Rift, where they are rather stuck.

FishORare.name: Chrab
FishORare.description: Uncommon finicky crustacean that settles in shipwrecks.

FishORare_Flavor.description: Makes its home amid the ruined remains of sea-faring vessels, but is quite choosy.

FishOLegendary.name: Squid
FishOLegendary.description: Elusive writhing denizen that haunts shipwrecks.

FishOLegendary_Flavor.description: Ships cannot always wreck themselves, thus it takes matters into its own suction cups.

FishPCommon.name: Pillartop
FishPCommon.description: Common headstrong denizen from cold lakes in the heavens.

FishPCommon_Flavor.description: From outside the water, it often appears merely as a reflection of those environs.

FishPRare.name: Chrestle
FishPRare.description: Uncommon armor-plated denizen from cold lakes in the heavens.

FishPRare_Flavor.description: Some say its armored shell was fashioned by Lord Hephaestus himself, who took pity.

FishPLegendary.name: Starsailor
FishPLegendary.description: Elusive graceful denizen from cold lakes in the heavens.

FishPLegendary_Flavor.description: While it feels most at home among the stars, it is content to be in the presence of gods.

FishQCommon.name: Lamprey
FishQCommon.description: Common bloodsucking denizen plucked from a raging tempest.

FishQCommon_Flavor.description: Symbiotic creatures that cling to the Father of All Monsters until their prey draws near.

FishQRare.name: Stormgullet
FishQRare.description: Uncommon scowling denizen plucked from a raging tempest.

FishQRare_Flavor.description: Its every breath produces gale-force winds and also an indescribable odor, in a bad way.

FishQLegendary.name: Chimaerid
FishQLegendary.description: Elusive monstrous denizen snagged from a raging tempest.

FishQLegendary_Flavor.description: A cross between several of the most hideous, voracious sea-creatures thus discovered.

FishChaosCommon.name: Mati
FishChaosCommon.description: Relatively common odd denizen of the infinite abyss.

FishChaosCommon_Flavor.description: Whether the large eye-like organ visible in it can see or not remains unknown.

FishChaosRare.name: Projelly
FishChaosRare.description: Relatively uncommon tentacled denizen of the infinite abyss.

FishChaosRare_Flavor.description: Primitive lifeform with a nonetheless indisputably long-lasting design.

FishChaosLegendary.name: Voidskate
FishChaosLegendary.description: Extraordinarily elusive gliding denizen of the infinite abyss.

FishChaosLegendary_Flavor.description: Though well-accustomed to sheer nothingness, is open to a change of scenery.

RandomLootGiftItem.name: {!Icons.RandomLoot} Mystery Boon
RandomLootGiftItem.description: Receive a {$Keywords.GodBoon} from one of the Olympians... {#ItalicFormat}but who?

WorldUpgradeQuestLog.name: Fated Intervention
WorldUpgradeQuestLog.description: Beseech the {$Keywords.CharFates} to lend their aid in a time of great need.

WorldUpgradeQuestLog_Flavor.description: Not even the Titan of Time ought be able to escape what the Fates may have in store for him... whatever that may be.

WorldUpgradeStoryReset.name: Returning to a Real Possibility
WorldUpgradeStoryReset.description: Reminisce at the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Fountain of the Dead {#Prev}to return to an earlier point in your journey, if you wish.

WorldUpgradeStoryReset_Flavor.description: Time marches ever forward. To what extent its course is predetermined, only the Fates can say.

WorldUpgradeChangeNextRunRNG.name: Acceptance of Another Fate
WorldUpgradeChangeNextRunRNG.description: Salute the {$Keywords.Shrine} to change your {$Keywords.RNG} prior to setting forth this night, if you wish...

WorldUpgradeChangeNextRunRNG_Flavor.description: An incantation for the superstitious and the bold, for who can say what the Fates had in store for us to begin with?

WorldUpgradeToolsShop.name: Night's Craftwork
WorldUpgradeToolsShop.description: Reveal {$Keywords.ToolPlural} within the {$Keywords.WeaponShop}. Unlock them to gather {!Icons.OreFSilverIcon}, {!Icons.MemPointsCommonIcon}, and more.

WorldUpgradeToolsShop_Flavor.description: The Earth yields its splendors readily to those bearing Night's silver and a worthy purpose.

WorldUpgradeWeaponUpgradeSystem.name: Aspects of Night and Darkness
WorldUpgradeWeaponUpgradeSystem.description: Reveal {$Keywords.AspectPlural} within the {$Keywords.WeaponShop} that further empower each {$Keywords.Weapon}.

WorldUpgradeWeaponUpgradeSystem_Flavor.description: The Nocturnal Arms belong to no one, but may be persuaded to let trusted bearers choose their form.

WorldUpgradeToolUpgradeSystem.name: Greater Favor of Gaia
WorldUpgradeToolUpgradeSystem.description: Reveal enhancements within the {$Keywords.WeaponShop} that further empower each {$Keywords.Tool}.

WorldUpgradeToolUpgradeSystem_Flavor.description: The Tools of the Unseen avail their purest forms to those familiar with their connection to this world.

WorldUpgradeCardUpgradeSystem.name: Consecration of Ashes
WorldUpgradeCardUpgradeSystem.description: Enhance the {$Keywords.CardTable} so that you can unlock the potential of your {$Keywords.CardPlural}. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeCardUpgradeSystem.OnActivateFinishedFunctionArgs.ResourceAmount}{#Prev}{!Icons.CardUpgradePointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeCardUpgradeSystem_Flavor.description: The sufficiently experienced and well-traveled witch can draw still more from the past.

WorldUpgradeMetaUpgradeSaveLayout.name: Spreading of Ashes
WorldUpgradeMetaUpgradeSaveLayout.description: Enhance the {$Keywords.CardTable} to preserve up to {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$MetaUpgradeSaveLayoutData.MaximumMetaUpgradeLayouts} {#Prev}different arrangements of your {$Keywords.CardPlural}.

WorldUpgradeMetaUpgradeSaveLayout_Flavor.description: Various possibilities always exist, however unlikely; the experienced witch considers more and more.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarSystem.name: Faith of Familiar Spirits
WorldUpgradeFamiliarSystem.description: Turn trusted beasts into your {$Keywords.FamiliarPlural}. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeFamiliarSystem.OnActivateFinishedFunctionArgs.ResourceAmount}{#Prev}{!Icons.FamiliarPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarSystem_Flavor.description: While not all Familiars are beasts, the unwavering nature of such creatures often makes them suitable.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarUpgradeSystem.name: Bravery of Familiar Spirits
WorldUpgradeFamiliarUpgradeSystem.description: Grow your bond with {$Keywords.FamiliarPlural}, to make them stronger with each treat. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeFamiliarUpgradeSystem.OnActivateFinishedFunctionArgs.ResourceAmount}{#Prev}{!Icons.FamiliarPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarUpgradeSystem_Flavor.description: Familiars, much like any of us, possess latent strength they may discover in due time.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarCostumeSystem.name: Alteration of Familiar Forms
WorldUpgradeFamiliarCostumeSystem.description: Choose from other appearances for your {$Keywords.FamiliarPlural}, in exchange for {!Icons.CosmeticsPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarCostumeSystem_Flavor.description: How we imagine ourselves and how we appear in some cases may be conflated.

WorldUpgradeMarket.name: Summoning of Mercantile Fortune
WorldUpgradeMarket.description: Persuade the {$Keywords.Broker} to appear, with whom you may trade {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon} for various resources.

WorldUpgradeMarket_Flavor.description: Bones of the dead remain a valuable commodity to those who know their secrets.

WorldUpgradeRunHistory.name: Summoning of Historic Travails
WorldUpgradeRunHistory.description: Persuade the {$Keywords.Historian} to appear, with whom you may review the outcomes of your every night.

WorldUpgradeRunHistory_Flavor.description: With knowledge of the past, future outcomes still cannot be anticipated; but it can make one interesting.

WorldUpgradeGameStats.name: Summoning of Personal Insights
WorldUpgradeGameStats.description: Persuade the {$Keywords.Statistican} to appear, from whom you may learn enlightening statistical details.

WorldUpgradeGameStats_Flavor.description: The House of Hades kept meticulous track of things, an art still practiced here and there.

WorldUpgradeMusicPlayer.name: Summoning of Musical Rhapsody
WorldUpgradeMusicPlayer.description: Persuade the {$Keywords.MusicPlayer} to appear, who can perform a variety of renowned melodies.

WorldUpgradeMusicPlayer_Flavor.description: Apollo, in his generosity, shared a wondrous talent for creating beautiful music with a select few.

WorldUpgradeMusicPlayerShuffle.name: Shuffling of Noted Ballads
WorldUpgradeMusicPlayerShuffle.description: Induce the {$Keywords.MusicPlayer} to optionally choose which melodies to play based on whim alone.

WorldUpgradeMusicPlayerShuffle_Flavor.description: One cannot always know exactly what one wishes to hear unless one's soul is listening.

WorldUpgradeAltRunDoor.name: Permeation of Witching-Wards
WorldUpgradeAltRunDoor.description: Gain the ability to traverse {$Keywords.Warded} gateways, such as the one leading to the surface...

WorldUpgradeAltRunDoor_Flavor.description: The wards fend off no foe but rather prevent an inexperienced Princess from venturing too far.

WorldUpgradeSurfacePenaltyCure.name: Unraveling a Fateful Bond
WorldUpgradeSurfacePenaltyCure.description: Forestall the effects of your bloodline's ancient Life-draining curse that bars you from the surface.

WorldUpgradeSurfacePenaltyCure_Flavor.description: The Fates deigned that those born of the Underworld are to be bound there; but that was then and this is now.

WorldUpgradeElementalBoons.name: Divination of the Elements
WorldUpgradeElementalBoons.description: Reveal hidden elemental affinities of various {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}; Olympians will offer {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} that use these.

WorldUpgradeElementalBoons_Flavor.description: The world's near-limitless possibilities are composed of a scarce few elementary particles.

WorldUpgradeGiftsShop.name: Kinship Fortune
WorldUpgradeGiftsShop.description: Update the {$Keywords.Broker} inventory with exotic goods suitable for gifting. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.GiftPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeGiftsShop_Flavor.description: Many traditions are difficult to break, and the Olympian gift-giving custom is one.

WorldUpgradeSellShop.name: Deathly Fortune
WorldUpgradeSellShop.description: Update the {$Keywords.Broker} to bestow {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon} in exchange for your {!Icons.ToolRodIconNoTooltip} {$WeaponShopItemData.ToolFishingRod.Name} catches.

WorldUpgradeSellShop_Flavor.description: No denizens of the deep are harmed as part of any such transaction.

WorldUpgradeExchangeShop.name: Earthly Fortune
WorldUpgradeExchangeShop.description: Update the {$Keywords.Broker} to bestow {!Icons.CosmeticsPointsIcon} in exchange for recycling most any surplus resource.

WorldUpgradeExchangeShop_Flavor.description: The experienced witch uses no more than what is required; the rest is for Gaia to keep safe.

WorldUpgradeTaverna.name: Rite of Social Solidarity
WorldUpgradeTaverna.description: Restore the {$Keywords.Taverna}, where Shades and others rest and recover. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.SuperGiftPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeTaverna_Flavor.description: After the House of Hades fell, those loyal to the Underworld King struggled to keep their spirits high.

WorldUpgradeBathHouse.name: Rite of Vapor-Cleansing
WorldUpgradeBathHouse.description: Restore the {$Keywords.HotSprings}, so they may be used {#ItalicFormat}(min. two guests at a time){#Prev}. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.GiftPointsRareIcon}.

WorldUpgradeBathHouse_Flavor.description: The roiling and neglected waters of the springs draw heat from the River Phlegethon somewhere below.

WorldUpgradeFishingPoint.name: Rite of River-Fording
WorldUpgradeFishingPoint.description: Restore the {$Keywords.FishingPier}, so it may be used {#ItalicFormat}(min. two guests at a time){#Prev}. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.GiftPointsEpicIcon}.

WorldUpgradeFishingPoint_Flavor.description: It was an ill portent when the River Cocytus flooded, and the pier was sealed off in all due haste.

CharFates.name: Three Fates
CharFates.description: Hidden daughters of {$Keywords.CharNyx}; each accidental bit of chance is likely their deliberate intent.

CharNyx.name: Nyx
CharNyx.description: Night Incarnate, by whose will and power much of the Underworld endures.

CharHades.name: Hades
CharHades.description: The god of the dead, appointed by the Fates themselves to rule the Underworld.

CharSelene.name: Selene
CharSelene.description: The Moon Incarnate, who rides silently across the night sky, observing all.

CharArtemis.name: Artemis
CharArtemis.description: The goddess of the hunt, who also serves the Silver Sisters from the shadows.

CharMoros.name: Moros
CharMoros.description: Doom Incarnate, a feared son of {$Keywords.CharNyx}, and emissary-guardian of the Three Fates.

CharCharon.name: Charon
CharCharon.description: The feared Boatman of the River Styx serves the Underworld in his own way.

CharChronos.name: Chronos
CharChronos.description: The Titan of Time usurped the House of Hades in his plans for conquest.

CharTyphon.name: Typhon
CharTyphon.description: The massive Father of All Monsters is worse than all his brood combined.

CharOdysseus.name: Odysseus
CharOdysseus.description: The Great Tactician, renowned for his wiles and daring escapes during his mortal days.

CharIcarus.name: Icarus
CharIcarus.description: The Shade of the son and the apprentice of the greatest mortal artisan that ever lived.

CharSkelly.name: Schelemeus
CharSkelly.description: The Crossroads training master once held a position of honor in the House of Hades.

CharNemesis.name: Nemesis
CharNemesis.description: Retribution Incarnate, feared daughter of {$Keywords.CharNyx}, and sentry of the Crossroads.

CharEris.name: Eris
CharEris.description: Strife Incarnate, the incendiary youngest daughter of {$Keywords.CharNyx}; uncontrollable.

CharChaos.name: Chaos
CharChaos.description: The sole being that gave rise to the primordial forces that still control this world.

CharNarcissus.name: Narcissus
CharNarcissus.description: His vanity wrought upon him a curse to stare forever at his own beautiful reflection.

CharDora.name: Dora
CharDora.description: She drifts through the afterlife oblivious of others, even her past self.

CharArachne.name: Arachne
CharArachne.description: Her pride in her craft, though not unfounded, provoked the gods to cut her down to size.

WorldUpgradeMorosUnlock.name: Doomed Beckoning
WorldUpgradeMorosUnlock.description: Beseech {$Keywords.CharMoros} to reappear, in accordance with the will of the {$Keywords.CharFates}.

WorldUpgradeMorosUnlock_Flavor.description: The Three Fates believe there is more for their brother to do, now that their List is delivered.

WorldUpgradeErisTrashPickup.name: Greater Removal of Rubbish
WorldUpgradeErisTrashPickup.description: Make it so whenever you collect {!Icons.TrashPointsIcon}, you automatically collect the rest in the vicinity.

WorldUpgradeErisTrashPickup_Flavor.description: The detrimental effects of Strife can never be entirely undone, but can be mitigated in various ways.

WorldUpgradeBadgeSeller.name: Long Arm of the Unseen
WorldUpgradeBadgeSeller.description: Proclaim this encampment's notoriety throughout the realms by donating {!Icons.CosmeticsPointsIcon} to the {$Keywords.Bartender}.

WorldUpgradeBadgeSeller_Flavor.description: The deepest shadows are far from invisible and induce the greatest fear.

WorldUpgradeNarcissusWaters.name: Purification of Crystal Clarity
WorldUpgradeNarcissusWaters.description: Restore the waters surrounding {$Keywords.CharNarcissus}, so that he may carry on fawning over himself.

WorldUpgradeNarcissusWaters_Flavor.description: If to love oneself to such an extent truly is a curse, then those thusly cursed perhaps are the fortunate ones.

WorldUpgradeMedeaTears.name: Essence of Sorrow
WorldUpgradeMedeaTears.description: Vaporize {!Icons.MixerHBoss} to their purest form, for use in some sort of concoction by the Witch of Shadows.

WorldUpgradeDoraMemory.name: Return of Latent Memories
WorldUpgradeDoraMemory.description: Compel the Shade called {$Keywords.CharDora} to remember something about her long-forgotten mortal days.

WorldUpgradeDoraMemory_Flavor.description: One's memory can deceive, warping the record of reality to suit the mind's whims; restoring it is delicate work.

WorldUpgradeTimeStop.name: Dissolution of Time
WorldUpgradeTimeStop.description: Suppress the ability for {$Keywords.CharChronos} to reconstitute himself night after night.

WorldUpgradeTimeStop_Flavor.description: It is said that Time cannot be stopped; but many such assertions are not always strictly true.

WorldUpgradePauseChronosFight.name: Power to Pause and Reflect
WorldUpgradePauseChronosFight.description: Suppress the ability for {$Keywords.CharChronos} to prevent you from pausing your {$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.Name} confrontations.

WorldUpgradePauseChronosFight_Flavor.description: Conscious beings can never fully grasp all facets of their nature; not even the master and incarnate of Time itself.

WorldUpgradeTimeSlowChronosFight.name: Temporal Fluctuation
WorldUpgradeTimeSlowChronosFight.description: Remove immunity from {$Keywords.CharChronos} to time-altering effects such as the {$Keywords.Spell} of {$TraitData.SpellTimeSlowTrait.Name}.

WorldUpgradeTimeSlowChronosFight_Flavor.description: Time marches ever forward, yet perception of its passage is susceptible to certain influence.

WorldUpgradeStormStop.name: Disintegration of Monstrosity
WorldUpgradeStormStop.description: Turn the boundless strength and rage of {$Keywords.CharTyphon} against him when he is weakened.

WorldUpgradeStormStop_Flavor.description: With sufficiently powerful reagents and intent, even immortality can be undone.

WorldUpgradeSkellyHealth.name: Augmentation of Bone Density
WorldUpgradeSkellyHealth.description: Significantly increase how much damage {$Keywords.CharSkelly} can take before falling to pieces.

WorldUpgradeSkellyHealth_Flavor.description: Calcified remains that are animated not by muscle and sinew but by supernatural means can be likewise reinforced.

WorldUpgradePostBossGiftRack.name: Kindred Keepsakes
WorldUpgradePostBossGiftRack.description: Manifest your collection of {$Keywords.Keepsakes} in the spaces separating each {$Keywords.Biome}.

WorldUpgradePostBossGiftRack_Flavor.description: To keep those dear to you in your heart is to have the strength to press on.

WorldUpgradeDoubleAdvanceKeepsakes.name: Quickening of Sentimental Value
WorldUpgradeDoubleAdvanceKeepsakes.description: Cause your equipped {$Keywords.Keepsakes} to reach the next rank {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeDoubleAdvanceKeepsakes.BonusRate:F} {#Prev}faster than before.

WorldUpgradeDoubleAdvanceKeepsakes_Flavo.description: The bond between comrades may grow stronger with time and, on occasion, even with distance.

WorldUpgradeBountyBoard.name: Abyssal Insight
WorldUpgradeBountyBoard.description: Activate the {$Keywords.BountyBoard} in the Training Grounds, then attempt its {$Keywords.PackagedBounties} for {!Icons.Mixer5CommonIcon}.

WorldUpgradeBountyBoard_Flavor.description: It is opaque, and yet the experienced witch knows there is a way to peer within.

WorldUpgradeBountyBoardRepeat.name: Abyssal Reflection
WorldUpgradeBountyBoardRepeat.description: Gain the ability to re-attempt cleared {$Keywords.PackagedBounties} at the {$Keywords.BountyBoard} for rewards of {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon}.

WorldUpgradeBountyBoardRepeat_Flavor.description: Creation is a process as well as a result; completion is an opportunity to start anew.

WorldUpgradeWakeHypnos.name: End to Deepest Slumber
WorldUpgradeWakeHypnos.description: Attempt to stir {$Keywords.CharHypnos} from his dormant state. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.HypnosPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeWakeHypnos_Flavor.description: Most slumber ends quickly and naturally, but a rare variety requires special care.

CharHypnos.name: Hypnos
CharHypnos.description: Sleep Incarnate, a son of {$Keywords.CharNyx}; he was fast asleep when the House of Hades fell.

WorldUpgradeWakeHypnosT2.name: End to Dearest Slumber
WorldUpgradeWakeHypnosT2.description: Reach deep into the psyche of {$Keywords.CharHypnos} to perhaps stir him from his dormant state. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.HypnosPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeWakeHypnosT2_Flavor.description: In the rarest cases of indefinite slumber, only the mind of the subject holds the key to its awakening.

WorldUpgradeReviveIcarus.name: Night Life for the Dead
WorldUpgradeReviveIcarus.description: Attempt to restore {$Keywords.CharIcarus} to his living form, temporarily. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.IcarusPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeReviveIcarus_Flavor.description: Only the most experienced necromancers dare attempt turn Shades whole again as though they yet lived.

WorldUpgradeReviveIcarusRepeatable.name: Night Life for the Dead
WorldUpgradeReviveIcarusRepeatable.description: Restore {$Keywords.CharIcarus} to his living form, quite briefly and only during a {!Icons.Moon_Full} {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Full Moon{#Prev}. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.IcarusPointsIconAlt}.

WorldUpgradeReviveIcarusRepeatable_Flavo.description: Only the most experienced necromancers dare attempt turn Shades whole again as though they yet lived.

WorldUpgradeRelationshipBar.name: Empath's Intuition
WorldUpgradeRelationshipBar.description: Update the {$Keywords.Codex} with insight into relationship status with one's acquaintances.

WorldUpgradeRelationshipBar_Flavor.description: If not even the deathless gods can fully understand the needs of others, what hope do mortals have?

WorldUpgradeWellShops.name: Rise of Stygian Wells
WorldUpgradeWellShops.description: Cause {$Keywords.RoomPlural} in the Underworld to sometimes contain a {$Keywords.WellShop}.

WorldUpgradeWellShops_Flavor.description: The Titan of Time called for all the Boatman's wells to be buried, as they could not be destroyed.

WorldUpgradePostBossWellShops.name: Surge of Stygian Wells
WorldUpgradePostBossWellShops.description: Cause a {$Keywords.WellShop} to appear in the space between each Underworld {$Keywords.Biome}.

WorldUpgradePostBossWellShops_Flavor.description: The Boatman's wells once were available only to those with the authority to cross the Underworld unfettered.

WorldUpgradeRestoreSellTraitShop.name: Revival of a Desecrating Pool
WorldUpgradeRestoreSellTraitShop.description: Reactivate the dormant {$Keywords.SellTraitShop} in the pathway leading to {$Keywords.BiomeI}.

WorldUpgradeRestoreSellTraitShop_Flavor.description: Eventually fell into disrepair after the House of Hades Security Specialist ceased putting it to use.

WorldUpgradePostBossSellTraitShops.name: Surge of Desecrating Pools
WorldUpgradePostBossSellTraitShops.description: Cause a {$Keywords.SellTraitShop} to always appear in the space between each Underworld {$Keywords.Biome}.

WorldUpgradePostBossSellTraitShops_Flavo.description: The Underworld was never in the jurisdiction of the Olympian gods, and their influence was to be washed away.

WorldUpgradeBreakableValue1.name: Propensity Toward Gold
WorldUpgradeBreakableValue1.description: Reveal {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Golden Urns {#Prev}in various {$Keywords.RoomPlural}, which yield up to {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$ObstacleData.BaseBreakable.BreakableValueOptions[1].MoneyDropOnDeath.MaxValue}{#Prev}{!Icons.Currency} once shattered.

WorldUpgradeBreakableValue1_Flavor.description: Promises of unimaginable riches were enough to swell the ranks of the Titan's legions.

WorldUpgradeSurfaceShops.name: Rush of Fresh Air
WorldUpgradeSurfaceShops.description: Cause {$Keywords.RoomPlural} on the surface to sometimes contain a {$Keywords.SurfaceShop}.

WorldUpgradeSurfaceShops_Flavor.description: A quick prayer to the god of swiftness can make all the difference in one's travels.

WorldUpgradePostBossSurfaceShops.name: Surge of Fresh Air
WorldUpgradePostBossSurfaceShops.description: Cause a {$Keywords.SurfaceShop} to appear in the space between each Surface {$Keywords.Biome}.

WorldUpgradePostBossSurfaceShops_Flavor.description: When traveling long distances, there are ways to make certain the god of swiftness takes notice.

WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitches1.name: Exhumed Troves
WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitches1.description: Cause {$Keywords.RoomPlural} throughout the Underworld to sometimes contain an {$Keywords.ChallengeSwitch}.

WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitches1_Flavor.description: Riches pilfered from the Underworld are now in the Titan's hold, though his grip may be loosened.

WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitchesSurface1.name: Arisen Troves
WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitchesSurface1.description: Cause {$Keywords.RoomPlural} upon the Surface to sometimes contain an {$Keywords.ChallengeSwitch}.

WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitchesSurface1_Fl.description: A reminder to surface-dwellers that when gods and Titans are at war, the world entire pays the price.

WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitchesExtra1.name: Eyes of Night and Darkness
WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitchesExtra1.description: Cause {$Keywords.RoomPlural} to sometimes contain a {$Keywords.EliteChallengeSwitch} or an {$Keywords.PerfectClearChallengeSwitch}.

WorldUpgradeChallengeSwitchesExtra1_Flav.description: Long did the Unseen bide their time, but now the time for shadowplay is ended.

WorldUpgradeMetaRewardStands.name: Bounties of the Infinite Abyss
WorldUpgradeMetaRewardStands.description: Cause {$Keywords.RoomPlural} in {$Keywords.BiomeI} or {$Keywords.BiomeQ} to sometimes contain a {$Keywords.ShrinePointReward}.

WorldUpgradeMetaRewardStands_Flavor.description: Those in service to the will of Night serve not for sake of reward but for the deed itself; but treasure can be nice.

WorldUpgradeMetaCardPointsCommonRunProgr.name: Ashen Memories of Life
WorldUpgradeMetaCardPointsCommonRunProgr.description: Whenever you claim rewards of {!Icons.MetaCardPointsCommonIcon}, gain {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$ConsumableData.MetaCardPointsCommonDrop.RunProgress.PropertyChanges.AddMaxHealth}{!Icons.HealthUp}{#Prev}.
Never again can ashes become that which they used to be, though faint traces of their past sometimes remain.

WorldUpgradeMetaCurrencyRunProgress.name: Bones of Arcane Wisdom
WorldUpgradeMetaCurrencyRunProgress.description: Whenever you claim rewards of {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon}, gain {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$ConsumableData.MetaCurrencyDrop.RunProgress.PropertyChanges.AddMaxMana}{!Icons.ManaUp}{#Prev}.

WorldUpgradeMetaCurrencyRunProgress_Flav.description: Bones often are the sole remaining trace of a thing; of where its spirit used to be.

WorldUpgradeGiftDropRunProgress.name: Nectar of Godly Savor
WorldUpgradeGiftDropRunProgress.description: Whenever you claim rewards of {!Icons.GiftPointsIcon}, gain {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.RandomPom}.

WorldUpgradeGiftDropRunProgress_Flavor.description: The gods themselves use this drink to strengthen their connections with each other.

WorldUpgradeErebusReprieve.name: Woodsy Lifespring
WorldUpgradeErebusReprieve.description: Reveal a hidden glade in {$Keywords.BiomeF}, where you may restore some {!Icons.HealthRestoreHome} amid the gloom.

WorldUpgradeErebusReprieve_Flavor.description: Infused with moonlight, some fresh water seeps from high above down into Erebus.

WorldUpgradeOceanusReprieve.name: Briny Lifespring
WorldUpgradeOceanusReprieve.description: Reveal a hidden chamber in {$Keywords.BiomeG}, where you may restore some {!Icons.HealthRestoreHome} in peace.

WorldUpgradeOceanusReprieve_Flavor.description: A purified spring can be difficult to locate in the depths of the sea.

WorldUpgradeTartarusReprieve.name: Golden Lifespring
WorldUpgradeTartarusReprieve.description: Reveal a hidden chamber in {$Keywords.BiomeI}, where you may restore some {!Icons.HealthRestoreHome} and elude your foes.

WorldUpgradeTartarusReprieve_Flavor.description: Among the countless interlocking chambers of Tartarus, few provided any sense of calm.

WorldUpgradeThessalyReprieve.name: Sandy Lifespring
WorldUpgradeThessalyReprieve.description: Reveal a hidden isle in the {$Keywords.BiomeO}, where you may restore some {!Icons.HealthRestoreHome} amid the tumult.

WorldUpgradeThessalyReprieve_Flavor.description: Once an enchanted glade, this bit of land survived when the surrounding countryside split in twain.

WorldUpgradeOlympusReprieve.name: Frozen Lifespring
WorldUpgradeOlympusReprieve.description: Reveal a hidden chamber within {$Keywords.BiomeP}, where you may restore some {!Icons.HealthRestoreHome} in quiet solitude.

WorldUpgradeOlympusReprieve_Flavor.description: Life-giving waters flow through the mountain, gathered in hidden aqueducts forgotten even by the gods.

WorldUpgradeOlympusStatues.name: Rage of the Elements
WorldUpgradeOlympusStatues.description: Re-energize the gods' statues on {$Keywords.BiomeP}, which you may then use to repel your foes.

WorldUpgradeOlympusStatues_Flavor.description: Those who rule the world can turn the very essence of reality against their foes.

WorldUpgradeFountainUpgrade1_Flavor.description: Water is a source of life, even for immortals; yet must freely flow to achieve its potential.

WorldUpgradeFountainUpgrade2.name: Purification of Fountain-Waters
WorldUpgradeFountainUpgrade2.description: Enhance {$Keywords.FountainPlural} so that they restore an additional {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$ObstacleData.HealthFountain.SetupEvents.2.DisplayValue:P}{#Prev}{!Icons.HealthRestoreHome}.

WorldUpgradeFountainUpgrade2_Flavor.description: Eliminating any traces of stagnation and contamination from water fulfills its life-giving purpose.

WorldUpgradeEphyraZoomOut.name: Summoning a Colony of Bats
WorldUpgradeEphyraZoomOut.description: Make use of {$Keywords.ZoomOutObject} in their cages around the {$Keywords.BiomeN}, to better orient yourself there.

WorldUpgradeEphyraZoomOut_Flavor.description: These bats were not freed from their cages, so much as forced to flee their homes.

WorldUpgradeFieldsRewardFinder.name: Reviving a Mournful Husk
WorldUpgradeFieldsRewardFinder.description: Make use of {$Keywords.RewardFinderObject} in the {$Keywords.BiomeH}, to better orient yourself there.

WorldUpgradeFieldsRewardFinder_Flavor.description: Saplings of surface origin that once shone like gold, and instilled a clarity of purpose.

WorldUpgradeErebusSafeZones.name: Circles of Protection
WorldUpgradeErebusSafeZones.description: Activate {$Keywords.SafeZone} found throughout {$Keywords.BiomeF}, to then use to your advantage.

WorldUpgradeErebusSafeZones_Flavor.description: A shape as perfect as it is inconspicuous, and can ward off all that is not meant to be within.

WorldUpgradeSafeZoneSpellCharge.name: Circles of the Moon
WorldUpgradeSafeZoneSpellCharge.description: Whenever you activate {$Keywords.SafeZone}, fully recharge your {$Keywords.Spell} if it is not ready.

WorldUpgradeSafeZoneSpellCharge_Flavor.description: On some nights, the Moon forms a perfect circle in the sky. That very shape is key to a strong connection.

WorldUpgradeShadeMercs.name: Necromantic Influence
WorldUpgradeShadeMercs.description: Gain the ability to {$Keywords.Sprint} into any {$Keywords.ShadeMerc} you encounter to turn them against your foes.

WorldUpgradeShadeMercs_Flavor.description: The bloodline of the Underworld's true King and Queen as yet commands authority.

WorldUpgradeUnusedWeaponBonus.name: Gathering of Ancient Bones
WorldUpgradeUnusedWeaponBonus.description: Cause a random {$Keywords.Weapon} each night to have {$TraitData.UnusedWeaponBonusTrait.Name}, yielding {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon} in each {$Keywords.RoomAlt}.

WorldUpgradeUnusedWeaponBonus_Flavor.description: Each night, one of the Nocturnal Arms nearby the {$Keywords.WeaponShop} shall take on a deathlike pallor.

WorldUpgradeUnusedWeaponBonusT2.name: Gathering of Subterranean Riches
WorldUpgradeUnusedWeaponBonusT2.description: Enhance {$Keywords.UnusedWeaponBonus} to also unearth {!Icons.GemPointsIcon} whenever you vanquish {$Keywords.BossPlural}.

WorldUpgradeUnusedWeaponBonusT2_Flavor.description: Few can access the vast and hidden wealth of the Underworld, though a certain birthright helps.

WorldUpgradeGarden.name: Flourishing Soil
WorldUpgradeGarden.description: Create {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeGarden.NumPlots} {#Prev}{$Keywords.GardenPlots}, for growing {!Icons.PlantFNightshadeIcon} and other plants. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.PlantFNightshadeSeedIcon}.

WorldUpgradeGarden_Flavor.description: The bounties of Gaia are hers to give or to withhold; asking nicely couldn't hurt.

WorldUpgradeGardenT2.name: Rich Soil
WorldUpgradeGardenT2.description: Create {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeGardenT2.NumPlots} {#Prev}{$Keywords.GardenPlots} in the space next to the others near the grove.

WorldUpgradeGardenT2_Flavor.description: From Earth herself, the miracle of everlasting life may flourish, climate permitting.

WorldUpgradeGardenT3.name: Verdant Soil
WorldUpgradeGardenT3.description: Create {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeGardenT3.NumPlots} {#Prev}{$Keywords.GardenPlots} in the remaining space next to the others near the grove.

WorldUpgradeGardenT3_Flavor.description: The support of a gardener often is the difference between a thriving plant and a mere husk.

WorldUpgradeHarvestUpgrade.name: Observance of Gaia's Secrets
WorldUpgradeHarvestUpgrade.description: Gain {#BoldFormatGraftDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeHarvestUpgrade.SeedChancePercent}% {#Prev}chance to find {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1 Seed {#Prev}for whatever you gather from {$Keywords.GardenPlots} whenever you harvest.

WorldUpgradeHarvestUpgrade_Flavor.description: Like most other living things, plants and funguses have a desire to persist above all else.

WorldUpgradeGardenHarvestAll.name: Green Hand of Gaia
WorldUpgradeGardenHarvestAll.description: Improve gathering from {$Keywords.GardenPlots} so that you harvest all flourished {$Keywords.GardenPlots} at once.

WorldUpgradeGardenHarvestAll_Flavor.description: Those sufficiently experienced may draw greenery from the Earth much like water from a well.

WorldUpgradeGardenMultiPlant.name: Greater Sowing of Gardens
WorldUpgradeGardenMultiPlant.description: Gain the ability to plant multiples of the same type of seed in all available {$Keywords.GardenPlots} at once.

WorldUpgradeGardenMultiPlant_Flavor.description: Mortal farmers tend to sow new plant life in vast fields, though there are simpler, even more ancient ways.

WorldUpgradeAutoHarvestOnExit.name: Greatest Gift of Gaia
WorldUpgradeAutoHarvestOnExit.description: Gain the power to automatically harvest any resources in each {$Keywords.RoomAlt} whenever you exit.

WorldUpgradeAutoHarvestOnExit_Flavor.description: Very few possess such a strong connection to the Earth that it would yield all its riches willingly.

WorldUpgradePinning.name: Forget-Me-Not
WorldUpgradePinning.description: Improve your memory. Press {IP} on recipes for at-a-glance reminders for which resources you need.

WorldUpgradePinning_Flavor.description: While witchcraft often demands careful memorization, there are tools as well as spells to aid with this.

WorldUpgradePinningBoons.name: Path to Desired Blessings
WorldUpgradePinningBoons.description: While viewing {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} in the {$Keywords.Codex}, press {IP} to track any offering requirements.

WorldUpgradePinningBoons_Flavor.description: Blessings are fickle by nature, much like the gods themselves; but so too do they have their patterns.

WorldUpgradeKeepsakeSaveFirst.name: Favored of All Keepsakes
WorldUpgradeKeepsakeSaveFirst.description: Prioritize a {$Keywords.KeepsakeAlt} to re-equip it automatically whenever you return to the Crossroads.

WorldUpgradeKeepsakeSaveFirst_Flavor.description: To draw the power from an artifact, it can be necessary to focus on it, until that process becomes second nature.

WorldUpgradeBoonList.name: Insight into Offerings
WorldUpgradeBoonList.description: Reveal a complete list of each Olympian's {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} {#ItalicLightFormat}(among other details) {#Prev}in the {$Keywords.Codex}.

WorldUpgradeBoonList_Flavor.description: Through connection to the gods may come a greater depth of knowledge of their power.

WorldUpgradeResourceFinder.name: Reagent Sensing
WorldUpgradeResourceFinder.description: Become alerted to valuable resources that may sometimes be found in any {$Keywords.RoomAlt}.

WorldUpgradeResourceFinder_Flavor.description: The experienced witch can quickly spot useful reagents most would readily ignore.

WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT2.name: Rivals of Depth and Sea
WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT2.description: Reveal the next rank of the {$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.Name} in the {$Keywords.Shrine} to face stronger {$Keywords.BossPlural}.

WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT2_Flavor.description: On the darkest nights, our greatest fears may become manifest, lest we assert control.

WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT3.name: Rivals of Plain and Peak
WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT3.description: Reveal the third rank of the {$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.Name} in the {$Keywords.Shrine} to face stronger {$Keywords.BossPlural}.

WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT3_Flavor.description: Fear grows in the dark, but so too can courage; there, limits are tested, broken, and surpassed.

WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT4.name: Rivals of Old and Rot
WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT4.description: Reveal the final rank of the {$MetaUpgradeData.BossDifficultyShrineUpgrade.Name} in the {$Keywords.Shrine} to face stronger {$Keywords.BossPlural}.

WorldUpgradeBossDifficultyT4_Flavor.description: Primordial forces in this world are so ancient that their own incalculable power may be even greater than they recall.

WorldUpgradeMixerShadow_Flavor.description: There are the shadows that we cast, there are shadows that dance in the candlelight, and then there is this.

WorldUpgradeNectar.name: Sweet Nectar
WorldUpgradeNectar.description: {$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeNectar.CookTime}{!Icons.Clock} {$Keywords.RecipeSpell}: Brew {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeNectar.OnActivateFinishedFunctionArgs.ResourceAmount}{#Prev}{!Icons.GiftPointsIconAlt}, a delectable substance suitable for gifting.

WorldUpgradeNectar_Flavor.description: The very best kind can only be brewed in a particular spot on Olympus, but a decent substitute can be had elsewhere.

WorldUpgradeAmbrosia.name: Shimmering Ambrosia
WorldUpgradeAmbrosia.description: {$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeAmbrosia.CookTime}{!Icons.Clock} {$Keywords.RecipeSpell}: Brew {#UpgradeFormatDark}+{$WorldUpgradeData.WorldUpgradeAmbrosia.OnActivateFinishedFunctionArgs.ResourceAmount}{#Prev}{!Icons.SuperGiftPointsIconAlt}, a rare delicacy suitable for gifting.

WorldUpgradeAmbrosia_Flavor.description: Demeter's old recipe features the complex and varied flavor profile of the Olympian original.

WorldUpgradeCardUpgradePoints2_Flavor.description: Faint flickers of the first light of creation yet retain their original potential.

WorldUpgradeFamiliarPoints_Flavor.description: An acquired taste even for beasts of particular refinement, ensuring only the strongest, purest bonds.

Song_ArtemisTheme.name: The Silver Sisters
Song_ArtemisTheme.description: Theme for when the goddess of the hunt dispatches her foes with ease.

Song_CharonShopTheme.name: Final Expense \[Renegade Mix\]
Song_CharonShopTheme.description: Theme for exchanging Gold for various illicit goods with the Boatman of the River Styx.

Song_ChaosTheme.name: Primordial Chaos
Song_ChaosTheme.description: Theme for paying witness the abyssal void at the origin of all creation.

Song_ChronosBossFightMusic.name: The Titan of Time
Song_ChronosBossFightMusic.description: Theme for confronting the usurper of the House of Hades where he rests on his stolen throne.

Song_ChronosBossFightMusicAlt.name: The End of Time
Song_ChronosBossFightMusicAlt.description: Theme for an ultimate confrontation against the Titan who deigned to challenge the Fates.

Song_DionysusMusic.name: Lap of Luxury
Song_DionysusMusic.description: Theme for partaking of the god of wine's revelry, if only for a short while.

Song_HypnosMusic.name: Deep Sleep
Song_HypnosMusic.description: Theme for drifting peacefully and interminably through the realm of sleep and dream.

Song_EndThemeAcoustic.name: In the Darkness
Song_EndThemeAcoustic.description: Theme for the god of the dead, having become the prisoner of Time.

Song_EndThemeOrchestral.name: In the Blood \[Reunion Mix\]
Song_EndThemeOrchestral.description: Theme for the royal family of the Underworld king and queen, and the fateful legacy they share.

Song_ArachneTheme.name: Spider Silk
Song_ArachneTheme.description: Theme for the silk-weaver whose work was said to be the envy of the gods themselves.

Song_MainTheme.name: Death to Chronos
Song_MainTheme.description: Theme for the saffron-veiled Princess of the Underworld and her lifelong pursuit.

Song_CirceTheme.name: Witch of Changing
Song_CirceTheme.description: Theme for one who casts the most powerful enchantments on her associates, or whoever necessary.

Song_MinibossTheme.name: King Vermin
Song_MinibossTheme.description: Theme for having to face the fiercest, yet occasionally smallest, foes of the Underworld.

Song_ClockworkTartarusRegular.name: Into Tartarus
Song_ClockworkTartarusRegular.description: Theme for infiltrating the lowest reaches of the Underworld in search of the Titan of Time.

Song_ClockworkTartarusMiniboss.name: (Thrashing) Into Tartarus
Song_ClockworkTartarusMiniboss.description: Theme for confronting the powerful wardens securing Tartarus against its enemies.

Song_FilthyArp.name: Sightless Shepherd
Song_FilthyArp.description: Theme for confronting the massive and ravenous guardian of Ephyra as he tends his flock.

Song_Ephyra2.name: Doomed City
Song_Ephyra2.description: Theme for traversing the surface, where the dead walk the earth with no place left to go.

Song_Ephyra3.name: The Necropolis
Song_Ephyra3.description: Theme for escaping the confines of the city of the damned.

Song_Exploration1.name: Edge of Erebus
Song_Exploration1.description: Theme for navigating the labyrinthine haunted woods between the surface and the Underworld.

Song_RunStart.name: The Crossroads

Ghost_Agent01.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}glory
Ghost_Agent01.description: Justice for the Underworld's rightful King and Queen! And for you, Your Grace!

Ghost_Agent02.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}backstabbing
Ghost_Agent02.description: Our trust in the Witch of the Crossroads is unwavering! (Well mine wavers a bit...)

Ghost_Agent03.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}spoiled meat
Ghost_Agent03.description: Death to Chronos, Princess! And may his be even less pleasant than mine!

Ghost_Agent04.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}adoration
Ghost_Agent04.description: She looked at me! When she saluted, she was looking right at me!

Ghost_Agent05.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}immortality
Ghost_Agent05.description: We stand ready to die for you, Princess! Again!

Ghost_Agent06.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}vermin
Ghost_Agent06.description: The Titan of Time can't be killed! Not even by Zeus and his brothers!

Ghost_Agent07.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}pestilence
Ghost_Agent07.description: A pox upon the enemies of Hades! And whosoever angers you, milady!

Ghost_Agent08.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}feasting
Ghost_Agent08.description: Wish I could spar with Nemesis just once... the rest of you are total pushovers.

Ghost_Agent09.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}curse
Ghost_Agent09.description: You have got to be joking. Do you have any idea who we're up against?

Ghost_Agent10.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}arrow
Ghost_Agent10.description: Most of us wouldn't even be here if not for the Olympians, you know...

Ghost_Agent11.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}falling
Ghost_Agent11.description: Do you have any idea how far down you have to go to get to Tartarus?

Ghost_Agent12.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}old age
Ghost_Agent12.description: Make Chronos pay for what he's done, Princess!

Ghost_Agent13.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}fame
Ghost_Agent13.description: I don't care what you say! I ought to be down in Elysium, not here!

Ghost_Agent14.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}charybdis
Ghost_Agent14.description: This takes me back to my days as a sailor... Master Odysseus remembers me, I'm sure!

Ghost_Agent15.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}fright
Ghost_Agent15.description: I am completely frozen with terror right now, I hope you know.

Ghost_Agent16.name: age of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}{$TempTextData.AgeOfDeath}
Ghost_Agent16.description: I got to say moonlight-guide-you to Artemis herself!!

Ghost_Agent17.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}snake bite
Ghost_Agent17.description: We've got Shades from all over the place turning up here lately!

Ghost_Agent18.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}poison
Ghost_Agent18.description: It's rather lively in the taverna, all things considered.

Ghost_Agent19.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}indulgence
Ghost_Agent19.description: We are unworthy of your presence, Your Grace! At least, I am!

Ghost_Agent20.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}allergy
Ghost_Agent20.description: We just returned with our latest report for Master Odysseus! Please take care, Princess!

Ghost_Agent21.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}immolation
Ghost_Agent21.description: What I wouldn't give to see the splendor of Elysium again...

Ghost_Agent22.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}plague
Ghost_Agent22.description: Life so often could be miserable, but death hasn't been easy lately either.

Ghost_Agent23.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}cyclops
Ghost_Agent23.description: I don't miss the surface. All my friends are here!

Ghost_Agent24.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}harpy
Ghost_Agent24.description: Is there really an entire fleet there sailing on Olympus?

Ghost_Agent25.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}python
Ghost_Agent25.description: Every single monster... they're all Typhon's children?

Ghost_Agent26.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}dracon
Ghost_Agent26.description: Don't know what's worse, between Typhon and the Titan of Time...

Ghost_Agent27.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}flying
Ghost_Agent27.description: Over there with the wings, isn't that the Daedalus kid?

Ghost_Agent28.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}peace
Ghost_Agent28.description: We really like what you've done with the place, Your Grace!

Ghost_Agent29.name: from: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}thessaly
Ghost_Agent29.description: We can't clean up after Eris fast enough, Your Grace!

Ghost_Agent30.name: from: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}ephyra
Ghost_Agent30.description: We salute you, O vanquisher of the Father of All Monsters!

Ghost_Recruit01.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}despair
Ghost_Recruit01.description: I thought that I would miss the Fields more...

Ghost_Recruit02.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}betrayal
Ghost_Recruit02.description: Are you certain it's all right for us to stay...?

Ghost_Recruit03.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}insight
Ghost_Recruit03.description: How long I wallowed by the bank of the Styx...

Ghost_Recruit04.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}strength
Ghost_Recruit04.description: I never would have left if not for you, Princess...

Ghost_Recruit05.name: greatest regret: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}falsehood
Ghost_Recruit05.description: It is difficult for me to believe any of this...

Ghost_Recruit06.name: greatest regret: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}silence
Ghost_Recruit06.description: We are grateful for your mercy, O Princess...

Ghost_Scout01.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}elysium
Ghost_Scout01.description: Apollo must be even better... he taught her, didn't he?

Ghost_Scout02.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}one last sunset
Ghost_Scout02.description: I could listen to her forever... I'd almost rather she shot me through the heart!

Ghost_Scout03.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}serenity
Ghost_Scout03.description: It can't be good that Strife herself is here... think she'd talk to us?

Ghost_Scout04.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}riches
Ghost_Scout04.description: Is it true about the Titan of Time? I can't believe it. I won't!

Ghost_Scout04a.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}rebirth
Ghost_Scout04a.description: We knew you had it in you, Princess!! Most of us!

Ghost_Scout05.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}long life
Ghost_Scout05.description: What happened on Olympus? Did she really do it? She really did...!

Ghost_Scout05a.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}swim-lessons
Ghost_Scout05a.description: The Father of All Monsters, vanquished! By our own Princess!!

Ghost_Scout06.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}fire
Ghost_Scout06.description: Prometheus did us no favors if you ask me!

Ghost_Scout07.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}lightning
Ghost_Scout07.description: Nobody move... Strife and Doom are both here...

Ghost_Scout08.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}one more bite
Ghost_Scout08.description: All hail Night's Champion!! We salute you!

Ghost_Scout09.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}sunshine
Ghost_Scout09.description: Rain certainly feels different when you're dead.

Ghost_Scout10.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}oblivion
Ghost_Scout10.description: It's really her... and you as well, Princess!

Ghost_Scout10a.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}wings
Ghost_Scout10a.description: I'm telling you, Apollo sings even better!

Ghost_Scout11.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}that song...
Ghost_Scout11.description: I cannot believe what used to be my ears...

Ghost_Scout11a.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}drowning
Ghost_Scout11a.description: This was the last music I ever heard... isn't it great?!

Ghost_Ranger01.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}an orchard
Ghost_Ranger01.description: The Underworld King and Queen are back!! Princess, you prevailed!

Ghost_Ranger02.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}to fly
Ghost_Ranger02.description: How is it we are working with that Titan now?

Ghost_Ranger03.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}to keep fighting
Ghost_Ranger03.description: The Underworld shall never be taken again, Princess!

Ghost_Ranger04.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}mushrooms
Ghost_Ranger04.description: Could you ask Lady Demeter to cease this rain, Your Grace?

Ghost_Ranger05.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}chariot
Ghost_Ranger05.description: I wonder what the Fates are like? They must have a sense of humor.

Ghost_Ranger06.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}vermin
Ghost_Ranger06.description: The renovation of the House of Hades is proceeding at pace, Princess!

Ghost_Ranger07.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}feasting
Ghost_Ranger07.description: Whenever this new age comes around, you can count me out.

Ghost_Ranger08.name: dying wish: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}the stars
Ghost_Ranger08.description: Selene smiled at me as I passed by! I'm certain of it!

Ghost_Ranger09.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}club
Ghost_Ranger09.description: We heard, Your Grace! Glory to the current Champion of Elysium!!

Ghost_Ranger10.name: cause of death: {#CauseOfDeathFormat}sling
Ghost_Ranger10.description: Ah, if only we could have been there to see the battle with the Prince!

ExtraChance.description: When you fall to {#PenaltyFormat}0{#Prev}{!Icons.Health}, automatically restore {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.LastStandHeal}%{#Prev}{!Icons.Health} and {!Icons.Mana}. Limited uses per night.

ExtraChanceAthena.name: {!Icons.ExtraChanceNoTooltip} Death Defiance
ExtraChanceAthena.description: When you fall to {#PenaltyFormat}0{#Prev}{!Icons.Health}, automatically restore {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.LastStandHeal}%{#Prev}{!Icons.Health} and {!Icons.Mana}. Used before similar effects.

ExtraChanceCat.name: Death Defiance
ExtraChanceCat.description: When you fall to {#PenaltyFormat}0{#Prev}{!Icons.Health}, automatically restore {#BoldFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipLastStandHealth}{#Prev}{!Icons.Health} once this night.

ExtraChanceMisc.name: {!Icons.ExtraChanceNoTooltip} Death Defiance
ExtraChanceMisc.description: {#ItalicFormat}Any {#Prev}effects that automatically activate when you fall to {#PenaltyFormat}0{#Prev}{!Icons.Health}, to help you survive.

DeathWeapon.name: Inferno-Bomb
DeathWeapon.description: Caustic explosives that are harmful to you, yet somehow pose no threat to your foes.

ReducedLootChoices.name: {#PenaltyFormat}Restricted
ReducedLootChoices.description: This is unavailable due to the lingering effects of {#BoldFormatGraft}Chaos{#Prev}.

ReserveMana.name: Prime
ReserveMana.description: A reduction to how much {!Icons.Mana} you can actively use this night.

ReserveManaAlt.description: A temporary reduction to how much {!Icons.Mana} you can actively use.

ReserveHealth.name: Prime
ReserveHealth.description: A temporary reduction to your Life Total, recovered in the next {$Keywords.RoomAlt}.

Hold.name: Channel
Hold.description: Press-and-hold to imbue your move with {$Keywords.Mana} to prepare a powerful {!Icons.Omega} effect.

RarityUpgrade.name: Rarify
RarityUpgrade.description: When choosing {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}, press {RY} to boost the {$Keywords.Rarity} of one that isn't already too rare.

SafeZone.name: Warding Circles
SafeZone.description: Once touched during {$Keywords.EncounterPlural}, these repel foes and their strikes for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$WeaponDataEnemies.SafeZone.AIData.FireDuration} Sec.{#Prev}

ShadeMerc.name: Lone Shades
ShadeMerc.description: Spirits lingering in some {$Keywords.EncounterPlural}. Rally them against your foes using {RU} {$Keywords.Sprint}.

ToolBookIcon.name: {!Icons.ToolBookIconNoTooltip} {$Keywords.ExorcismPointPlural}
ToolBookIcon.description: {#BoldFormatGraft}Frinos {#Prev}makes {$Keywords.ExorcismPointPlural} more likely, and pacifies them on command.

ToolPickIcon.name: {!Icons.ToolPickIconNoTooltip} {$Keywords.PickaxePointPlural}
ToolPickIcon.description: {#BoldFormatGraft}Raki {#Prev}makes {$Keywords.PickaxePointPlural} more likely, and collects from them on command.

ToolRodIcon.name: {!Icons.ToolRodIconNoTooltip} {$Keywords.FishingPointPlural}
ToolRodIcon.description: {#BoldFormatGraft}Toula {#Prev}makes {$Keywords.FishingPointPlural} more likely, and catches their inhabitants on command.

ToolShovelIcon.name: {!Icons.ToolShovelIconNoTooltip} {$Keywords.DiggingPointPlural}
ToolShovelIcon.description: {#BoldFormatGraft}Hecuba {#Prev}makes {$Keywords.DiggingPointPlural} more likely, and may uncover them on command.

ToolGatherIcon.name: {!Icons.ToolGatherIconNoTooltip} {$Keywords.HarvestPointPlural}
ToolGatherIcon.description: {#BoldFormatGraft}Gale {#Prev}makes {$Keywords.HarvestPointPlural} more likely, and retrieves any on command.

DeathIcon.name: {!Icons.DeathIcon} Night's Embrace
DeathIcon.description: The essence of {$Keywords.Mana} found in primordial darkness.

ThanatosAspectBuff.name: Mortality
ThanatosAspectBuff.description: A fleeting bonus of {$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipIncrement:P} {$Keywords.Crit} chance for your {$Keywords.Omega}, up to a max of {$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipMax:P}.

EosAspectShot.name: Daybreaker
EosAspectShot.description: A slow seeking shot that blasts nearby foes and copies your {$Keywords.SpecialSet}. Limit {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev}at a time.

Fuel.name: Sprouted
Fuel.description: Damaging effects from Olympians make this last up to {#BoldFormatGraft}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec. {#Prev}when next you use it.

Random.name: Fates' Whim
Random.description: This night, you have had {#BoldFormatGraft}0{#Prev}{!Icons.ReRollAlt} and avoided Olympian-summoning {$Keywords.Keepsakes}.

RandomWarning.name: {#AltPenaltyFormat}Inactive
RandomWarning.description: {#ItalicFormat}Not so fast! {#Prev}Your {$Keywords.CardPlural} are granting {!Icons.ReRollAlt}. Deactivate such {$Keywords.CardPlural} to use this.

RandomWarningAlt.name: {#AltPenaltyFormat}Inactive
RandomWarningAlt.description: {#ItalicFormat}Not so fast! {#Prev}You had {!Icons.ReRollAlt} or equipped an Olympian-summoning {$Keywords.KeepsakeAlt} this night.

BlockedByEnding.name: {#AltPenaltyFormat}Unavailable
BlockedByEnding.description: This comrade is currently investigating the eradication of {$Keywords.CharTyphon} and cannot aid you.

BlockedByEndingAlt.name: {#AltPenaltyFormat}Unavailable
BlockedByEndingAlt.description: This {$Keywords.KeepsakeAlt} cannot be used at this time...

RaiseDeadAspect.name: Ankh Scepter
RaiseDeadAspect.description: {#ItalicBoldFormat}{$Keywords.HiddenAspect}: {#Prev}{$Keywords.AttackSet} create damaging fields, {$Keywords.SpecialSet} draw foes in.

TripleAspect.name: Crow Cutters
TripleAspect.description: {#ItalicBoldFormat}{$Keywords.HiddenAspect}: {#Prev}{$Keywords.AttackSet} hit {$TraitData.DaggerTripleAspect.NumHits} times, heavy {$Keywords.SpecialSet} hit repeatedly in flight.

TripleAspectStrike.name: Blood Triad
TripleAspectStrike.description: Land an {$Keywords.Attack}, {$Keywords.Special}, and {$Keywords.OmegaAlt} against a foe to inflict heavy damage.

AutofireAspect.name: Devil Sparks
AutofireAspect.description: {#ItalicBoldFormat}{$Keywords.HiddenAspect}: {#Prev}Fires automatically; {$Keywords.AttackEX} and {$Keywords.SpecialEX} rain hell for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipAutofireDuration} Sec.

RallyAspect.name: Rock Lion Mace
RallyAspect.description: {#ItalicBoldFormat}{$Keywords.HiddenAspect}: {#Prev}Heavy {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialEX} deal damage in a wide area.

FrenzyBuff.name: Berserk
FrenzyBuff.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackSet} and {$Keywords.SpecialSet} are {$TooltipData.ExtractData.ReportedSpeed:F} faster and restore {#UpgradeFormat}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.FrenzyLifeStealAmount}{#Prev}{!Icons.Health} per foe hit. Lasts {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.FrenzyDuration} Sec.

Overheat.name: Valkyrie
Overheat.description: Your {$Keywords.Attack} fires continuously, but you cannot use {$Keywords.Omega}. Lasts {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.OverheatDuration} Sec.

ComboBuff.name: Destructive
ComboBuff.description: Your {$Keywords.AttackEX} deals {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.ExecuteBonus:P} {#Prev}damage per Rank, then resets this effect.

DaggerBlockBuff.name: Riposte
DaggerBlockBuff.description: You are {$Keywords.Invulnerable} for {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.InvulnerableDuration} Sec. {#Prev}Your next {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} {#Prev}strikes have {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.CritChance:P} {#Prev}{$Keywords.Crit} chance.

Bounties.name: Testaments
Bounties.description: What must be done according to the {#BoldFormatGraft}Oath of the Unseen{#Prev}; grant {!Icons.WeaponPointsRare} on completion.

ShrinePoints.name: Fear
ShrinePoints.description: Adjusted in the {#BoldFormatGraft}Oath of the Unseen{#Prev}. The higher this is, the harder things will be for you.

ShrinePointReward.name: Gift of Night
ShrinePointReward.description: An offering of {!Icons.GemPointsIcon}, {!Icons.CardUpgradePointsIcon}, {!Icons.WeaponPointsRareIcon}, {!Icons.Mixer5CommonIcon}, or {!Icons.FamiliarPointsIcon}, which can be claimed if enough {!Icons.ShrinePoint} is in the air.

PackagedBounties.name: Chaos Trials
PackagedBounties.description: Various challenges from the {$Keywords.BountyBoard}, which award {!Icons.Mixer5CommonIcon} on completion.

Block.name: Parry
Block.description: Prevent damage from most types of direct attacks. Can be repeated after {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TraitData.DaggerBlockAspect.OnWeaponChargeFunctions.FunctionArgs.Cooldown} Sec.

Shells.name: {!Icons.LobAmmo_NoTooltip} Shells
Shells.description: Ammunition for your {A2} {$Keywords.AttackSet}. Retrieve from the field to re-use.

ReRollAlt.name: {!Icons.ReRoll} Change of Fate
ReRollAlt.description: Used to alter various outcomes this night, depending on your {#BoldFormatGraft}Arcana{#Prev}.

RecipeSpell.name: Recipe
RecipeSpell.description: A repeatable formula that takes time, during which the {#BoldFormatGraft}Cauldron {#Prev}cannot be used.

RepeatSpell.name: Charm
RepeatSpell.description: A repeatable magick spell with some immediate effect.

MarketSellOK.name: Surplus Resource
MarketSellOK.description: You have little need for this right now.

MarketEarlySellWarning.name: {!Icons.NeededResource} Needed Resource
MarketEarlySellWarning.description: This still has other uses, so you may wish to hold onto it for now.

Costume.name: Outfit
Costume.description: A special look and bonus that lasts till your {$Keywords.PlayerArmor} is depleted from taking damage.

CosmeticAdd.name: Extra Decor
CosmeticAdd.description: Adds a new decorative touch in the vicinity. You may put it away if you wish.

CosmeticAltAdd.name: Extra Decor
CosmeticAltAdd.description: Adds a new decorative touch, or replaces a similar one. You may also put it away.

CosmeticSwap.name: Alt Decor
CosmeticSwap.description: Replaces something in the vicinity with a new look. You may always switch back.

CosmeticDefault.name: Plain Decor
CosmeticDefault.description: Modest starting furnishings. You may switch this to {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap} of the same type.

CosmeticDeck.name: Card Backs
CosmeticDeck.description: Different {$Keywords.CardPlural} themes, which you can set for each saved arrangement.

FamiliarCostume.name: Form
FamiliarCostume.description: How your {$Keywords.Familiar} appears. Changes have no effect on abilities.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01.name: Bedding, Crossroads
Cosmetic_TentBlanket01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Clean and unwrinkled; prevents some amount of body heat from escaping.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01_Flavor.description: The Princess long insisted on sleeping under the stars but eventually conceded to this.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01a.name: Bedding, Silk
Cosmetic_TentBlanket01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Cool and smooth, with earthy hues and a symmetrical diamond pattern.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01a_Flavor.description: The silken threads as well as the dyes used all come from the woods of Erebus.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01b.name: Bedding, Moon
Cosmetic_TentBlanket01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Light and delicate, with silver embroidery representing the grace of Selene.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01b_Flavor.description: The Moon cannot warm the skin, but the spirit; this blanket, a little of each.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01c.name: Bedding, Woolen
Cosmetic_TentBlanket01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Warm and soft, despite feeling somewhat coarse on first impression.

Cosmetic_TentBlanket01c_Flavor.description: Made from materials sourced from the one and only shepherd's flock in the city of Ephyra.

Cosmetic_ApolloLyre.name: Lyre, Replica of Apollo's
Cosmetic_ApolloLyre.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Crafted to look virtually indistinguishable from that of the god of light.

Cosmetic_ApolloLyre_Flavor.description: No one can play as beautifully as Apollo, though owners of this beautiful piece cannot play at all.

Cosmetic_TentHangingOrnaments01.name: Talismans, Hanging
Cosmetic_TentHangingOrnaments01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Ensures the privacy of one's tent, paradoxically through eyeball imagery.

Cosmetic_TentHangingOrnaments01_Flavor.description: The Earth is always pulling us toward where we came from, and where we shall return.

Cosmetic_TentCandle01.name: Candle, Crimson
Cosmetic_TentCandle01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Poured from enchanted materials and anointed with three drops of blood.

Cosmetic_TentCandle01_Flavor.description: The Headmistress lit this candle when the Princess first arrived in the Crossroads, to mark her passage.

Cosmetic_TentCandle01a.name: Candle, Morbid
Cosmetic_TentCandle01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Poured from ancient materials and anointed with the ashes of great balladeers.

Cosmetic_TentCandle01a_Flavor.description: To mortals, death is one of the most mysterious and captivating forces of all; a source of inspiration, then.

Cosmetic_TentCandle01b.name: Candle, Toadhead
Cosmetic_TentCandle01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Poured with a dash of mineral-rich swamp water and made with real glass.

Cosmetic_TentCandle01b_Flavor.description: Perhaps it was the toad's ability to subsist either above the water's surface or below that first compelled her.

Cosmetic_EmployeeOfTheMonth.name: Placard, House of Hades
Cosmetic_EmployeeOfTheMonth.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Once used to honor loyal service to the god of the dead; now a relic.

Cosmetic_EmployeeOfTheMonth_Flavor.description: An old yet sturdy frame showing evidence of heavy use, though the likenesses it featured are nowhere to be found.

Cosmetic_ThanPoster.name: Signboard, House of Hades
Cosmetic_ThanPoster.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Once used to motivate Shades serving the god of the dead; now a relic.

Cosmetic_ThanPoster_Flavor.description: Featured on this piece, Death Incarnate must have been a model Houseservant and an imposing presence.

Cosmetic_WitchTrinkets01.name: Baubles, Glass
Cosmetic_WitchTrinkets01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Contains various objects of such an obscure nature that their use is purely aesthetic.

Cosmetic_WitchTrinkets01_Flavor.description: How are we to know that the Princess of the Dead is a witch most powerful, if not for the abundance of these?

Cosmetic_WitchTrinkets02.name: Trinkets, Bronze
Cosmetic_WitchTrinkets02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Creates the appearance of having various quaint interests and pastimes.

Cosmetic_WitchTrinkets02_Flavor.description: With the extensive study of magick comes a predisposition toward certain eccentricities, or the other way around.

Cosmetic_TentQuilt.name: Quilt, Childhood
Cosmetic_TentQuilt.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Provides a perhaps-false sense of security and a perhaps-true sense of comfort.

Cosmetic_TentQuilt_Flavor.description: The Shades agreed to dispose of this when the Princess of the Dead indicated she no longer needed it, yet here it is.

Cosmetic_TentShelf01.name: Shelving, Rustic
Cosmetic_TentShelf01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Offers serviceable storage space with a natural touch.

Cosmetic_TentShelf01_Flavor.description: The Princess would routinely reorganize her belongings on this, yet never settled on the optimal layout.

Cosmetic_TentShelf01a.name: Shelving, Lunar
Cosmetic_TentShelf01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Offers secure storage space with a nocturnal touch.

Cosmetic_TentShelf01a_Flavor.description: Dark lacquer and silver embellishments add a touch of extravagance to this beautifully crafted piece.

Cosmetic_TentShelf01b.name: Shelving, Fancy
Cosmetic_TentShelf01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Offers ample storage space with an elegant touch.

Cosmetic_TentShelf01b_Flavor.description: Various sliding compartments, some well-hidden, give this piece a secretive air.

Cosmetic_FanPoster01.name: Wall-Scroll, Scylla
Cosmetic_FanPoster01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Portrays an infamous sea-monster and an obscure musical act.

Cosmetic_FanPoster01_Flavor.description: One's musical tastes can be so deeply personal that to share them is to make oneself feel highly vulnerable.

Cosmetic_FanPoster01a.name: Wall-Scroll, Selene
Cosmetic_FanPoster01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Portrays the great Titaness and incarnate of the Moon.

Cosmetic_FanPoster01a_Flavor.description: Even when invisible to the eye, she is always watching, guiding us night after night, cycle after cycle.

Cosmetic_FanPoster01b.name: Wall-Scroll, Heracles
Cosmetic_FanPoster01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Portrays the imposing demigod son of Zeus, known as the mightiest of men.

Cosmetic_FanPoster01b_Flavor.description: To mortalkind, he is the pinnacle of sheer strength and of unwavering service to the gods.

Cosmetic_TentRug.name: Rug, Silver Sisters
Cosmetic_TentRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Enhances the entryway to the tent with durable softness.

Cosmetic_TentRug_Flavor.description: Woven with four sets of threads, each of a different vibrant hue, all colors of the Moon.

Cosmetic_TentTable01.name: Table, Rustic
Cosmetic_TentTable01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Indigo fabric covers this circular but otherwise plain piece.

Cosmetic_TentTable01_Flavor.description: Recovered from the River Acheron long ago; the water damage is superficial and hidden from view.

Cosmetic_TentTable01a.name: Table, Spiked
Cosmetic_TentTable01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Sleek surface, cool to the touch, yet adorned with dangerous-looking points.

Cosmetic_TentTable01a_Flavor.description: The circumference of the piece is adorned with an old incantation used for finding lost loves.

Cosmetic_TentTable01b.name: Table, Lunar
Cosmetic_TentTable01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Hard porous surface, with colors of dusky marble and moonstone.

Cosmetic_TentTable01b_Flavor.description: How the artisan was able to chisel the stones with such precision is a matter of dispute.

Cosmetic_TentTable01c.name: Table, Woodsy
Cosmetic_TentTable01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Rough richly complex surface, the branches of an ancient tree.

Cosmetic_TentTable01c_Flavor.description: Even the Tree of Life loses limbs from time to time; yet they have purpose in death, and new branches grow.

Cosmetic_FrinosRock01.name: Habitat, Mossy
Cosmetic_FrinosRock01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: A simple resting-place for a special amphibian.

Cosmetic_FrinosRock01_Flavor.description: The softness and dampness of the moss makes this a favored long-time abode for Frinos.

Cosmetic_FrinosRock01a.name: Habitat, Lighted
Cosmetic_FrinosRock01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: A fanciful resting-place for a special amphibian.

Cosmetic_FrinosRock01a_Flavor.description: The lights come from tiny bioluminescent plants that provide a source of nourishment, and entertainment.

Cosmetic_FrinosRock01b.name: Habitat, Aquatic
Cosmetic_FrinosRock01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: A comfortable resting-place for a special amphibian.

Cosmetic_FrinosRock01b_Flavor.description: The shape of this particular habitat provides a nostalgic reminder of wistful evenings as a tad.

Cosmetic_RespawnCircleFlowers.name: Flowers, Scattered
Cosmetic_RespawnCircleFlowers.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Adorns the Magick Circle with a calming floral arrangement.

Cosmetic_RespawnCircleFlowers_Flavor.description: One may return to shadows only to a place of utmost safety and solitude, and these can be a contributing factor.

Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01.name: Sculpture, Amphibian
Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A stone-chiseled likeness of {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Frinos {#Prev}near the Magick Circle.

Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01_Flavor.description: The woods of Erebus are beset with creatures that prefer the dampness and the dark; here, they are honored.

Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01a.name: Sculpture, Raven
Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A stone-chiseled likeness of {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Raki {#Prev}near the Magick Circle.

Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01a_Flavor.description: Ravens have always watched over the dead, often from the moment mortal life slips away.

Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01b.name: Sculpture, Feline
Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A stone-chiseled likeness of {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Toula {#Prev}near the Magick Circle.

Cosmetic_FamiliarEffigy01b_Flavor.description: Natural-born hunters who fend for themselves; is it any wonder witches prefer them?

Cosmetic_MorosChaise.name: Recliner, Fateful
Cosmetic_MorosChaise.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A comfortable seat to never rest upon, near to where {$Keywords.CharMoros} typically resides.

Cosmetic_MorosChaise_Flavor.description: Even feared Doom Incarnate must require a bit of reprieve from time to time.

Cosmetic_MorosTentCanopy.name: Draping, Fateful
Cosmetic_MorosTentCanopy.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Some colorful protection from the elements, near to where {$Keywords.CharMoros} typically resides.

Cosmetic_MorosTentCanopy_Flavor.description: The Crossroads are near enough to the surface that its harsh and unpredictable weather patterns sometimes cut in.

Cosmetic_MorosScrolls.name: Parchments, Fateful
Cosmetic_MorosScrolls.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Crisscrossed shelving with ample reading material, near to where {$Keywords.CharMoros} typically resides.

Cosmetic_MorosScrolls_Flavor.description: Those with access to the Crossroads are invited to learn its ways, and some of its history and secrets.

Cosmetic_MorosRug.name: Rug, Fateful
Cosmetic_MorosRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A fine spot on which to ponder the future, near to where {$Keywords.CharMoros} typically resides.

Cosmetic_MorosRug_Flavor.description: Woven in honor of the Fates using threads believed to have come from their own looms.

Cosmetic_MorosSpools.name: Threads, Fateful
Cosmetic_MorosSpools.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: An arrangement of colorful threads, near to where {$Keywords.CharMoros} typically resides.

Cosmetic_MorosSpools_Flavor.description: A potentially-auspicious reminder of the connections shared by all living beings.

Cosmetic_MorosTerrain.name: Cobblestones, Fateful
Cosmetic_MorosTerrain.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Engraved stone flooring, neatly arranged near to where {$Keywords.CharMoros} typically resides.

Cosmetic_MorosTerrain_Flavor.description: Reminds us of the weavings of the Fates, the process itself: the apportioning, the spinning, and the cutting.

Cosmetic_NemesisChair.name: Throne, Chthonic
Cosmetic_NemesisChair.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A big imposing seat, near to where {$Keywords.CharNemesis} typically resides.

Cosmetic_NemesisChair_Flavor.description: They once held a contest as to who could avoid sitting longer; the victor is to be determined.

Cosmetic_NemesisRug.name: Flooring, Chthonic
Cosmetic_NemesisRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A spot on which to regard the night, near to where {$Keywords.CharNemesis} typically resides.

Cosmetic_NemesisRug_Flavor.description: Reminds us that Night is all around us; not merely above, but also below.

Cosmetic_NemesisGrindstone.name: Grindstone, Chthonic
Cosmetic_NemesisGrindstone.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A device for honing keen edges, near to where {$Keywords.CharNemesis} typically resides.

Cosmetic_NemesisGrindstone_Flavor.description: While the blade called Stygius requires no sharpening, its bearer can never be too certain.

Cosmetic_NemesisBraziers.name: Braziers, Chthonic
Cosmetic_NemesisBraziers.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A pair of tall pale flames, near to where {$Keywords.CharNemesis} typically resides.

Cosmetic_NemesisBraziers_Flavor.description: The bright gleam of silver is perhaps at its most beautiful in this particular light.

Cosmetic_NemesisScales.name: Scales, Balanced
Cosmetic_NemesisScales.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A large and symbolic set of scales, near to where {$Keywords.CharNemesis} typically resides.

Cosmetic_NemesisScales_Flavor.description: Fairness is to be carefully doled out, and may punishment befall those who expect more than their share.

Cosmetic_OdysseusRug.name: Rug, Grecian
