Cosmetic_OdysseusRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A durable mortal-woven piece, near to where {$Keywords.CharOdysseus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_OdysseusRug_Flavor.description: Recovered mostly intact from the City of Ephyra, where it was no longer doing anybody any good.

Cosmetic_OdysseusRug02.name: Rug, Nautical
Cosmetic_OdysseusRug02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: An artful piece depicting a beaked ship, near to where {$Keywords.CharOdysseus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_OdysseusRug02_Flavor.description: The ship depicted is said to have had all its pieces replaced, raising provocative questions as to whether it remains itself.

Cosmetic_OdysseusTable01.name: War Table, Rustic
Cosmetic_OdysseusTable01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Functional for considering various maps, plans, and strategies; oft used by {$Keywords.CharOdysseus}.

Cosmetic_OdysseusTable01_Flavor.description: Assembled from wood fallen from yew trees, which grow in abundance in Erebus.

Cosmetic_OdysseusTable01a.name: War Table, Grecian
Cosmetic_OdysseusTable01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Grander furnishings for grander plans, near to where {$Keywords.CharOdysseus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_OdysseusTable01a_Flavor.description: Fashioned from the wood of an olive tree, and inscribed with prayers to the gods for peace.

Cosmetic_OdysseusVase.name: Urn, Grecian
Cosmetic_OdysseusVase.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Ample storage for more plans and reports, near to where {$Keywords.CharOdysseus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_OdysseusVase_Flavor.description: Once held the ashen remains of mortal warriors, some of whom reside in these Crossroads now.

Cosmetic_ErisTrashcan.name: Basket, Rubbish
Cosmetic_ErisTrashcan.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Receptacle suitable for storing detritus, near to where {$Keywords.CharEris} typically resides.

Cosmetic_ErisTrashcan_Flavor.description: While there is no reason to think Strife would ever use such a thing, one nevertheless can hope.

Cosmetic_ErisWarningSign01.name: Warning Sign, Strife
Cosmetic_ErisWarningSign01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Automatically detects when {$Keywords.CharEris} is in the vicinity, for better or worse.

Cosmetic_ErisWarningSign01_Flavor.description: No Shade has taken responsibility for the sign's unflattering likeness, leading to speculation that Eris created it herself.

Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01.name: Tassels, Silver Sisters
Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Protective and decorative coiled charms near to the Princess' tent.

Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01_Flavor.description: Whether in the heavens, on the surface, or within the Earth, together they shine.

Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01a.name: Tassels, Astral
Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Protective and decorative star-shaped charms near to the Princess' tent.

Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01a_Flavor.description: A reminder that not even the innumerable stars in the sky can overcome the dark of night.

Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01b.name: Tassels, Stygian
Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Protective and decorative blood-red charms near to the Princess' tent.

Cosmetic_MainHangingTassles01b_Flavor.description: Colored with rare dyes made with waters from the River Styx, among other things.

Cosmetic_MainHangingRope01.name: Rope, Knotted
Cosmetic_MainHangingRope01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Binding knots with rings of silver hanging above the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_MainHangingRope01_Flavor.description: These were already here when the Princess of the Dead first arrived in the Crossroads.

Cosmetic_MainHangingRope01a.name: Rope, Astral
Cosmetic_MainHangingRope01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Star-shaped charms attached with braided silver hanging above the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_MainHangingRope01a_Flavor.description: They seem to enhance the faint light of the stars, which is permitted in the Crossroads.

Cosmetic_RiverLanterns.name: Lights, Water
Cosmetic_RiverLanterns.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Smattering of small floating lights scattered about the river.

Cosmetic_RiverLanterns_Flavor.description: Souls lamenting deep in the waters of the Cocytus probably could use this bit of cheer.

Cosmetic_RiverLanterns02.name: Lights, Moonbox
Cosmetic_RiverLanterns02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Collection of square-shaped lights scattered about the river.

Cosmetic_RiverLanterns02_Flavor.description: A pinch of Moon Dust helps give the boxes their buoyancy and vibrant hue.

Cosmetic_MainTeaLights.name: Lights, Earth
Cosmetic_MainTeaLights.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Smattering of small floating lights scattered about the main grounds.

Cosmetic_MainTeaLights_Flavor.description: Bits of the stars themselves create the ever-lasting spark in these little bits of brightness.

Cosmetic_MainLanterns01.name: Lanterns, Crossroads
Cosmetic_MainLanterns01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Conical fixtures illuminate the Crossroads with a soft light.

Cosmetic_MainLanterns01_Flavor.description: Whatever burns within generates no heat at all, but casts deep shadows.

Cosmetic_MainLanterns01a.name: Lanterns, Divine
Cosmetic_MainLanterns01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Ornate fixtures illuminate the Crossroads with a light akin to that of Olympus.

Cosmetic_MainLanterns01a_Flavor.description: Aether from the Mount Olympus causes light of every color imaginable to swirl within.

Cosmetic_MainLanterns01b.name: Lanterns, Lunar
Cosmetic_MainLanterns01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Moon-shaped fixtures illuminate the Crossroads with the light of the night sky.

Cosmetic_MainLanterns01b_Flavor.description: Selene herself anointed these with just the right balance of darkness and light.

Cosmetic_BrokerRug.name: Rug, Merchant's
Cosmetic_BrokerRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A fine spot on which to barter, near to where the {$Keywords.Broker} typically resides.

Cosmetic_BrokerRug_Flavor.description: A storied history of favorable trades is said to have occurred on this very surface.

Cosmetic_BrokerLantern01.name: Lantern, Merchant's
Cosmetic_BrokerLantern01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A lone hanging light fixture, near to where the {$Keywords.Broker} typically resides.

Cosmetic_BrokerLantern01_Flavor.description: Lighter than it looks, such that it can be supported by your run-of-the-mill gnarled branch.

Cosmetic_BrokerWagon01.name: Wagon, Scavenger's
Cosmetic_BrokerWagon01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A heavy-duty supply cart, near to where the {$Keywords.Broker} typically resides.

Cosmetic_BrokerWagon01_Flavor.description: Features ample storage, plus the latest protective charms for warding off a variety of daemons.

Cosmetic_BrokerWagon02.name: Wagon, Soothsayer's
Cosmetic_BrokerWagon02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A richly elegant supply cart, near to where the {$Keywords.Broker} typically resides.

Cosmetic_BrokerWagon02_Flavor.description: Versatile compartments, sturdy wheels, and keen drapery make this the cart of the future.

Cosmetic_Cauldron01.name: Cauldron, Crossroads
Cosmetic_Cauldron01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Forged from the most ancient silver and inlaid with various warding stones.

Cosmetic_Cauldron01_Flavor.description: The Witch of the Crossroads never once said just for how long she has used this old reliable pot.

Cosmetic_Cauldron01a.name: Cauldron, Astral
Cosmetic_Cauldron01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Forged from unbreakable metals procured from the mountain of the gods.

Cosmetic_Cauldron01a_Flavor.description: Magick is practiced all throughout the world, including across the surface and sometimes in the heavens.

Cosmetic_Cauldron01b.name: Cauldron, Python
Cosmetic_Cauldron01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Forged with the scales of a great beast and imbued with its venom.

Cosmetic_Cauldron01b_Flavor.description: Though slain by the gods, the serpent's fierce spirit yet lives in a way, as all spirits tend to do.

Cosmetic_CauldronRing01.name: Circle, Stone
Cosmetic_CauldronRing01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Stonework engraved with protective wards surrounding the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronRing01_Flavor.description: 'In shadow, I serve; to shadow, I return. May moonlight guide me, and shadows conceal me.'

Cosmetic_CauldronRing01a.name: Circle, Lunar
Cosmetic_CauldronRing01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Silver engraved with protective wards surrounding the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronRing01a_Flavor.description: 'Great Titaness, the Eye of Night, I draw you down; lend me your might!'

Cosmetic_CauldronRing01b.name: Circle, Earthen
Cosmetic_CauldronRing01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Intertwining branches engraved with protective wards surrounding the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronRing01b_Flavor.description: 'Great Tree of Life and Mother Gaia, listen to my heart's desire!'

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01.name: Pillars, Crossroads
Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Strong stone monoliths that stand tall to either side of the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01_Flavor.description: Three in number, for the threefold nature of the Witch of the Crossroads.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01a.name: Pillars, Eclipse
Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Shadowy monoliths that stand tall to either side of the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01a_Flavor.description: The Crossroads cannot be found by the uninvited, so strongly do the shadows gather there.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01b.name: Pillars, Lunar
Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Glimmering monoliths that stand tall to either side of the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01b_Flavor.description: They serve almost as a bridge between the heavens, the surface, and the Underworld.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01c.name: Pillars, Stygian
Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Ornate bejeweled monoliths that stand tall to either side of the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Cauldron{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_CauldronPillars01c_Flavor.description: Crafted from discarded remnants of the House of Hades from before the Titan of Time took it over.

Cosmetic_BathChangingScreens.name: Screens, Folding
Cosmetic_BathChangingScreens.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Standing panels behind which the incurably modest disrobe, set near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Hot Springs{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_BathChangingScreens_Flavor.description: Shame is an emotion deeply held by many mortals, sometimes even into death.

Cosmetic_BathTowelRacks.name: Racks, Bronze
Cosmetic_BathTowelRacks.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Include various plush fabrics suitable for drying off, set near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Hot Springs{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_BathTowelRacks_Flavor.description: The cutting briskness of the night air may be diminished by these to some extent.

Cosmetic_BathSoaps.name: Ointments, Alchemic
Cosmetic_BathSoaps.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Assorted collection of oils and other cleansing materials, set near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Hot Springs{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_BathSoaps_Flavor.description: Purification is a delicate process requiring a great many ingredients for different parts and purposes.

Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01.name: Sconces, Crossroads
Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Conical fixtures cast a soft light, near to where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01_Flavor.description: Sleep takes hold more readily in darkness than in light, though here it matters not.

Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01a.name: Sconces, Winged
Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Ornamental fixtures cast a warm light, near to where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01a_Flavor.description: Though the children of Nyx typically have little to do with each other, at times they do watch out for each other.

Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01b.name: Sconces, Floral
Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Vibrant fixtures cast a soothing light, near to where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosLanterns01b_Flavor.description: Believed to help induce dreams of bright springtime days, for those who take comfort in such things.

Cosmetic_HypnosPillars01.name: Columns, Mossy
Cosmetic_HypnosPillars01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Set of six stately monoliths, near to where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosPillars01_Flavor.description: After reasonable attempts to wake Sleep failed, these would let him continue on in peace.

Cosmetic_HypnosPillars01a.name: Columns, Deathly
Cosmetic_HypnosPillars01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Set of six grim monoliths, near to where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosPillars01a_Flavor.description: Sleep is the brother of Death, and they are closer than many children of Nyx; this way, perhaps closer still.

Cosmetic_HypnosRug.name: Carpet, Stygian
Cosmetic_HypnosRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Elegant red surface leading up to where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosRug_Flavor.description: Based on the very same pattern and fabric once used by the Pool of Styx within the House of Hades.

Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01.name: Pillarets, Stone
Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Numerous small standing-stones encircling where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01_Flavor.description: The rough-shod circle forms a simple but effective barrier against various negative sentiments.

Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01a.name: Pillarets, Winged
Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Numerous well-crafted little columns encircling where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01a_Flavor.description: The winged tops represent the means by which we quickly slip into oblivion when Sleep takes hold.

Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01b.name: Pillarets, Fluted
Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Numerous intricately-fashioned stone columns encircling where {$Keywords.CharHypnos} typically resides.

Cosmetic_HypnosPedestal01b_Flavor.description: The semblance of wind instruments chiseled in the rock suggest music by which to drift off to Sleep.

Cosmetic_FarmBench01.name: Seating, Fountain
Cosmetic_FarmBench01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Mossy stone bench across from the Fountain of the Dead behind the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Garden{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_FarmBench01_Flavor.description: While quaint, no self-respecting Princess of the Dead would be caught dead sitting on this when a great task is at hand.

Cosmetic_FarmPillars01.name: Pillarets, Fountain
Cosmetic_FarmPillars01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Paired stone formations leading to the Fountain of the Dead behind the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Garden{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_FarmPillars01_Flavor.description: The otherwise-unassuming stone is said to have come all the way from the House of Hades after it was usurped.

Cosmetic_FarmWell01.name: Water-Well, Fountain
Cosmetic_FarmWell01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Rugged water-storage structure near the Fountain of the Dead behind the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Garden{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_FarmWell01_Flavor.description: Proximity to the River of Lamentation limits the utility of the waters this collects, but it has a certain charm.

Cosmetic_FarmGardenTools01.name: Toolset, Farmer's
Cosmetic_FarmGardenTools01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Sturdy but unremarkable tools for if ever the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Garden {#Prev}needed tending.

Cosmetic_FarmGardenTools01_Flavor.description: Claimed to have once belonged to a mortal farmer who knew the goddess of seasons.

Cosmetic_Aquarium.name: Aquarium, Enchanted
Cosmetic_Aquarium.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Houses all forms of aquatic life plucked from the waters, set near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Fishing Pier{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_Aquarium_Flavor.description: Deceptively small in appearance, it extends deep into myriad hidden grottoes of every variety.

Cosmetic_FishingSign01.name: Pier Sign, Soby
Cosmetic_FishingSign01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Painted wooden signage at the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Fishing Pier{#Prev}, depicting a mournful river denizen.

Cosmetic_FishingSign01_Flavor.description: The Soby is common in the channel of the River Styx that flows through the Mourning Fields; but not here.

Cosmetic_FishingSign01a.name: Pier Sign, Goldfish
Cosmetic_FishingSign01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Painted wooden signage at the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Fishing Pier{#Prev}, depicting a glimmering river denizen.

Cosmetic_FishingSign01a_Flavor.description: When grains of gold began to flow through what once was the bank of the Styx, creatures such as these soon arrived.

Cosmetic_FishingSign01b.name: Pier Sign, Ribeye
Cosmetic_FishingSign01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Painted wooden signage at the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Fishing Pier{#Prev}, depicting a skeletal river denizen.

Cosmetic_FishingSign01b_Flavor.description: Oft mistaken for carcasses, creatures such as these lurk in the River Acheron in search of the Underworld's entry-point.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01.name: Tables, Rustic
Cosmetic_TavernaTables01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Serviceable well-built furnishings at which to gather, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01_Flavor.description: What can one do in a hidden encampment but conspire with one's comrades until the appointed time?

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01a.name: Tables, Stygian
Cosmetic_TavernaTables01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Crafted from pure silver and adorned with rich fabric, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01a_Flavor.description: Suitable for moonlit rituals, divinations, seances, and other nighttime gatherings.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01b.name: Tables, Crystal
Cosmetic_TavernaTables01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Crafted from luminous stone resembling the hue of moonlight, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01b_Flavor.description: Some mortal-constructed temples to the gods take inspiration from this intricate style.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01c.name: Tables, Unseen
Cosmetic_TavernaTables01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Adorned with the colors of the Silver Sisters, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaTables01c_Flavor.description: Dyes sourced from each of the realms create the distinctive hues of the braided adornments.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01.name: Benches, Rustic
Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Durable if plain seating arrangements, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01_Flavor.description: Few Shades so much as bother to try to sit, though tend to appreciate fondly-remembered aesthetics.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01a.name: Benches, Stygian
Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Cloth-covered red seating arrangements, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01a_Flavor.description: Those of the Crossroads are expected to remember the House of Hades, made easier on one of these.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01b.name: Benches, Crystal
Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Sleek polished stone seating, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01b_Flavor.description: Mortals typically dislike having to rest on cold surfaces, but Shades have no such qualms.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01c.name: Benches, Unseen
Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Comfortable and colorful seating, for all in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaChairs01c_Flavor.description: The durable fabric of the cushions is stuffed with fibers from a delicate but sturdy plant.

Cosmetic_TavernaMusicStage01.name: Stage, Wood-Plank
Cosmetic_TavernaMusicStage01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Stylish yet durable flooring directly beneath the {$Keywords.MusicPlayer}.

Cosmetic_TavernaMusicStage01_Flavor.description: The comfort of the artist is of utmost importance when it comes to performing music in a live environment.

Cosmetic_TavernaMusicStage02.name: Stage, Cobblestone
Cosmetic_TavernaMusicStage02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Traditional and sturdy flooring directly beneath the {$Keywords.MusicPlayer}.

Cosmetic_TavernaMusicStage02_Flavor.description: A strong connection to the Earth itself perhaps is key to musicianship of a certain kind.

Cosmetic_TavernaShrimpCocktails.name: Serving Cups, Fancy
Cosmetic_TavernaShrimpCocktails.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Delectable-looking arrangements of what appear to be Shrimp, near the {$Keywords.Bartender}.

Cosmetic_TavernaShrimpCocktails_Flavor.description: Shrimp are the primary influence on these, though had no direct involvement in their creation.

Cosmetic_TavernaCauldron01.name: Cooking-Pot, Iron
Cosmetic_TavernaCauldron01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Unsophisticated heat-conducting receptacle, in the middle of the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaCauldron01_Flavor.description: A time-honored design leaving little room for improvement, despite repeated efforts.

Cosmetic_TavernaCauldron02.name: Cooking-Pot, Rustic
Cosmetic_TavernaCauldron02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Wooden-lidded heat-conducting receptacle, in the middle of the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaCauldron02_Flavor.description: Optimal for stews and hot beverages; vents enough heat to provide warmth even when the coals have died.

Cosmetic_TavernaStarMosaic.name: Mosaic, Gemstone
Cosmetic_TavernaStarMosaic.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Carefully-laid stones of agate, lapis, and citrine form this central flooring in the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Taverna{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_TavernaStarMosaic_Flavor.description: Suggests the myriad bounties and beauty of the Earth for all those taking solace in its surroundings.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01.name: Dais, Stone
Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Inverted stone platform, set right where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01_Flavor.description: To be on the same level as the Shades of the Crossroads, Commander Schelemeus must lower himself.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01a.name: Dais, Morbid
Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Chthonic stone platform, set right where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01a_Flavor.description: Reminds Shades that even small mistakes in battle could bring death, at least back when they lived.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01b.name: Dais, Infernal
Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Traditional stone platform, set right where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01b_Flavor.description: The grim authority of the House of Hades seems to emanate through these stones.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01c.name: Dais, Hypnotic
Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Poppy-covered stone platform, set right where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_SkellyFloor01c_Flavor.description: Helps train the stalwart disciples of the Crossroads never to fall asleep while on duty.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01.name: Effigies, Straw
Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Basic targets for martial training, set behind where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01_Flavor.description: The Commander could not bear to look at these, so strong was his desire to train with his subjects firsthand.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01a.name: Effigies, Titan
Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Imposing targets for martial training, set behind where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01a_Flavor.description: 'Find the Titan. Slay the Titan.' In the end, the task of the Princess of the Underworld was as simple as that.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01b.name: Effigies, Immortal
Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Inspiring targets for martial training, set behind where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01b_Flavor.description: Even the best-trained warrior may be cowed in the face of an opponent of surpassing skill.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01c.name: Effigies, Hypnotic
Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01c.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Mesmerizing targets for martial training, set behind where {$Keywords.CharSkelly} typically resides.

Cosmetic_TrainingDummy01c_Flavor.description: Instill in the attacker the idea of having to strive for greatness in every waking moment.

Cosmetic_CatScratcher.name: Post, Scratching
Cosmetic_CatScratcher.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Something to occasionally claw and gouge, near to where {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Toula {#Prev}typically resides.

Cosmetic_CatScratcher_Flavor.description: The instinct of the hunter of course is to hunt; or failing that, to ruin furniture.

Cosmetic_BirdHouse.name: Birdhouse, Luxurious
Cosmetic_BirdHouse.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Well-stocked little domicile, near to where {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Raki {#Prev}typically resides.

Cosmetic_BirdHouse_Flavor.description: Those born with wings strive to use them, though having a place to rest them is welcome, too.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm.name: Charm, Amphibian
Cosmetic_ExitCharm.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Conspicuous embellishment to the warded gateways leading both above and below.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm_Flavor.description: The amphibian is a master of survival in various habitats, and likewise does this charm inspire perseverance.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm02.name: Charm, Avian
Cosmetic_ExitCharm02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Beaked embellishment to the warded gateways leading both above and below.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm02_Flavor.description: The raven is sometimes seen as a portent of ill fortune, but the same can be said of the witch.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm03.name: Charm, Feline
Cosmetic_ExitCharm03.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Aloof embellishment to the warded gateways leading both above and below.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm03_Flavor.description: The cat serves no master but her own whim, and reminds us that we may choose our own way.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm04.name: Charm, Canine
Cosmetic_ExitCharm04.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Stately embellishment to the warded gateways leading both above and below.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm04_Flavor.description: The hound is dignified yet a consummate survivor, scavenging whatever she requires wheresoever she may go.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm05.name: Charm, Musteline
Cosmetic_ExitCharm05.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Mischievous embellishment to the warded gateways leading both above and below.

Cosmetic_ExitCharm05_Flavor.description: The polecat is as slippery as beasts can get, able to escape even the most unfavorable situation.

Cosmetic_DoraBench01.name: Bench, Rustic
Cosmetic_DoraBench01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDefault}: Durable if plain seating, just behind where {$Keywords.CharDora} currently resides.

Cosmetic_DoraBench01_Flavor.description: Those in the Training Grounds know to avoid it lest they be mocked for sitting as opposed to standing.

Cosmetic_DoraBench02.name: Bench, Haunted
Cosmetic_DoraBench02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticSwap}: Vaguely sinister seating, just behind where {$Keywords.CharDora} currently resides.

Cosmetic_DoraBench02_Flavor.description: Shades may tirelessly haunt their victims if they so choose, though may still welcome a bit of rest.

Cosmetic_DreamRug.name: Rug, Hypnotic
Cosmetic_DreamRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Woven from dream-soft fabrics to accent the grounds near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Dream Comforter{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_DreamRug_Flavor.description: There are two ways to quickly drift into deep slumber: great comfort and great exhaustion. This helps with either.

Cosmetic_Poppies.name: Flowerbed, Poppy
Cosmetic_Poppies.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Dense patches of red flowers, surrounding the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Dream Comforter{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_Poppies_Flavor.description: Though lacking the magickal properties of Poppies from deep in the Earth, these still create a calming atmosphere.

Cosmetic_ThanCutout.name: Standee, Thanatos
Cosmetic_ThanCutout.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A rendition of a fearsome Death Incarnate, to loom over the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Dream Comforter{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_ThanCutout_Flavor.description: An imposing piece cut not merely from parchment, but seemingly from the subconscious of Sleep himself.

Cosmetic_AsteriusPlush.name: Plush, Bull of Minos
Cosmetic_AsteriusPlush.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: An overstuffed portrayal of the famous half-bull, set near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Dream Comforter{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_AsteriusPlush_Flavor.description: Favored by Sleep Incarnate himself, this unexpectedly soft promotional item is not as imposing as the real Bull of Minos.

Cosmetic_StarJar.name: Receptacle, Shiny Star
Cosmetic_StarJar.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A translucent container for an excess of Shiny Stars, placed near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Dream Comforter{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_StarJar_Flavor.description: To some, a source of pride; to others, a reminder of worries overcome; and to others still, a sticker jar.

Cosmetic_HypnosStatue.name: Bust, Hypnos
Cosmetic_HypnosStatue.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: An elegant, frankly flattering likeness of Sleep Incarnate, set near the {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Dream Comforter{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_HypnosStatue_Flavor.description: Sculpted by Daedalus himself after Hypnos heroically achieved ten work-related quotas without fail.

Cosmetic_AmbientFrogs.name: Habitat, Amphibian
Cosmetic_AmbientFrogs.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Mix of hidden aqueous vegetation that small frogs and such find irresistible.

Cosmetic_AmbientFrogs_Flavor.description: Life is a delicate system that revolves around death, and these creatures comprise a useful little corner.

Cosmetic_AmbientCats.name: Habitat, Feline
Cosmetic_AmbientCats.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Carefully-chosen assortment of loose string and boxes to draw out any stray cats.

Cosmetic_AmbientCats_Flavor.description: Solitary creatures whose affections can seem feigned, lending them an irresistible complexity.

Cosmetic_AmbientDogs.name: Habitat, Canine
Cosmetic_AmbientDogs.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Well-scented surfaces upon which any stray dogs in the vicinity ought come to rest.

Cosmetic_AmbientDogs_Flavor.description: Their innate loyalty and inability to be deceiving makes them well-loved among beasts.

Cosmetic_ChronosHourglass.name: Hourglass, Golden
Cosmetic_ChronosHourglass.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Theoretically measures a fixed period of time, and in an elegant way.

Cosmetic_ChronosHourglass_Flavor.description: Death to Chronos: a reminder of inevitability and the transience of the present.

Cosmetic_HermesShoes.name: Footwear, Winged
Cosmetic_HermesShoes.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Said to significantly enhance mobility, but are many sizes too large.

Cosmetic_HermesShoes_Flavor.description: Even if they did fit, surely they would combust on contact with the fire-stepping Princess.

Cosmetic_IcarusWings.name: Wings, Prototype
Cosmetic_IcarusWings.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Based on an earlier design that {$Keywords.CharIcarus} was able to significantly improve.

Cosmetic_IcarusWings_Flavor.description: The feathers used were both functionally necessary as well as a clear source of inspiration.

Cosmetic_PandoraJar.name: Jar, Nostalgic
Cosmetic_PandoraJar.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Based on an old design that spurs latent memories, mostly good.

Cosmetic_PandoraJar_Flavor.description: Reminiscent of a traditional wedding gift, suitable for storing everything from pickles to daemons.

Cosmetic_OdysseusTrojanHorse.name: Equine Sculpture, Wooden
Cosmetic_OdysseusTrojanHorse.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Scale replica of an infamous military decoy, near to where {$Keywords.CharOdysseus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_OdysseusTrojanHorse_Flavor.description: The real thing must have been quite a bit bigger if it truly fit the Great Tactician and his elite assault force.

Cosmetic_ErisJerkyShelf.name: Shelving, Pantry
Cosmetic_ErisJerkyShelf.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Optimal for storing copious snack-foods, not far from where {$Keywords.CharEris} typically resides.

Cosmetic_ErisJerkyShelf_Flavor.description: Originally built for the distribution of Cyclops Jerky. The shelves are spaced to be of little other use.

Cosmetic_ErisRug.name: Rug, Tri-Wing
Cosmetic_ErisRug.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A colorful piece reminiscent of moody skies, near where {$Keywords.CharEris} typically resides.

Cosmetic_ErisRug_Flavor.description: Woven from fabric that can sustain a lot of nightly punishment and cleans easily.

Cosmetic_ArtemisLyre.name: Lyre, Replica of Artemis'
Cosmetic_ArtemisLyre.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Similar to a piece owned by the goddess of hunt, near where she sometimes resides.

Cosmetic_ArtemisLyre_Flavor.description: Perhaps her and her brother's excellence at all things stems from their competitive spirit.

Cosmetic_ArtemisTarget.name: Target, Archery
Cosmetic_ArtemisTarget.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Suggests skill with bow-and-arrow, near to where {$Keywords.CharArtemis} sometimes resides.

Cosmetic_ArtemisTarget_Flavor.description: Though the goddess of the hunt visits the Crossroads to take her mind off many things, archery is exempted.

Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01.name: Flower Circle, Pale
Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A bright and delicate arrangement, near to where {$Keywords.CharArtemis} sometimes resides.

Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01_Flavor.description: Deepens the sense of serenity in the small clearing where the goddess of the hunt likes to sing.

Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01a.name: Flower Circle, Bluish
Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01a.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A soft and understated arrangement, near to where {$Keywords.CharArtemis} sometimes resides.

Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01a_Flavor.description: One can feel even more unseen than usual within a circle such as this, if so desired.

Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01b.name: Flower Circle, Crimson
Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01b.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: A bold and vibrant arrangement, near to where {$Keywords.CharArtemis} sometimes resides.

Cosmetic_ArtemisFlowerCircle01b_Flavor.description: Slightly bolsters the sense of protection against negative energy while within it.

Cosmetic_ArtemisAmaranthus.name: Amaranth, Red
Cosmetic_ArtemisAmaranthus.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Sturdy plants favored by the goddess of the hunt, near to where she sometimes resides.

Cosmetic_ArtemisAmaranthus_Flavor.description: This tall, nutritious grain perhaps takes its reddish hue from the River Styx.

Cosmetic_FallenLeaves01.name: Leaves, Autumnal
Cosmetic_FallenLeaves01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Crisp naturally-fallen foliage from cooler climes scattered about the main grounds.

Cosmetic_FallenLeaves01_Flavor.description: Perhaps Lady Demeter herself bade these to fall from the branches that they might find their way to the Crossroads.

Cosmetic_FallenLeaves02.name: Leaves, Vernal
Cosmetic_FallenLeaves02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAltAdd}: Vibrant naturally-fallen foliage from warmer climes scattered about the main grounds.

Cosmetic_FallenLeaves02_Flavor.description: These typically would wither and rot in but a few nights, though a minor enchantment keeps them fresh.

Cosmetic_CharonOar.name: Oar, Styx-Splitting
Cosmetic_CharonOar.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Spare wooden paddle, near the docks where the {$Keywords.Broker} typically resides.

Cosmetic_CharonOar_Flavor.description: The Underworld Boatman goes through more of these than he would ever admit.

Cosmetic_ArachneTapestry.name: Tapestry, Silken
Cosmetic_ArachneTapestry.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Depicts the opulence of Olympus, near where the {$Keywords.Broker} typically resides.

Cosmetic_ArachneTapestry_Flavor.description: Cannot possibly be the Arachne original, which is said to have been destroyed after her victory in a fateful contest.

Cosmetic_HecateKey.name: Banner, Threefold Moon
Cosmetic_HecateKey.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Proud insignia of the Silver Sisters hanging from the great {#BoldFormatGraftDark}Tree of Life{#Prev}.

Cosmetic_HecateKey_Flavor.description: The Unseen have no banners, for the light of the Moon marks their passage. Yet banners nonetheless are made.

Cosmetic_SkellyZagreusStatue.name: Statue, Abandoned
Cosmetic_SkellyZagreusStatue.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Stone slab reduced by chisel to the unmistakable form of the Prince of the Underworld.

Cosmetic_SkellyZagreusStatue_Flavor.description: A commission for the House of Hades that was lost due to a series of clerical errors that then were carefully covered up.

Cosmetic_CollectableOdysseus.name: Chthonic Chid, Odysseus
Cosmetic_CollectableOdysseus.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the Great Tactician.

Cosmetic_CollectableOdysseus_Flavor.description: “I do like to travel, but... I think you'll always know where to find me.”

Cosmetic_CollectableSkelly.name: Chthonic Chid, Schelemeus
Cosmetic_CollectableSkelly.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the Training Master.

Cosmetic_CollectableSkelly_Flavor.description: “Less greeting, more beating, if you would be so kind!”

Cosmetic_CollectableMoros.name: Chthonic Chid, Moros
Cosmetic_CollectableMoros.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after Doom Incarnate.

Cosmetic_CollectableMoros_Flavor.description: “Take heart knowing the Fates themselves believe that you'll succeed!”

Cosmetic_CollectableHecate.name: Chthonic Chid, Hecate
Cosmetic_CollectableHecate.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the Witch of the Crossroads.

Cosmetic_CollectableHecate_Flavor.description: “Your training shall never be complete. And I would know if you stand any chance at all against our enemy!”

Cosmetic_CollectableNemesis.name: Chthonic Chid, Nemesis
Cosmetic_CollectableNemesis.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after Retribution Incarnate.

Cosmetic_CollectableNemesis_Flavor.description: “You don't deserve this. But you're stuck with it. So the only question is, what are you going to do about it now?”

Cosmetic_CollectableCharon.name: Chthonic Chid, Charon
Cosmetic_CollectableCharon.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the Underworld Boatman.

Cosmetic_CollectableIcarus.name: Chthonic Chid, Icarus
Cosmetic_CollectableIcarus.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the apprentice of Daedalus.

Cosmetic_CollectableIcarus_Flavor.description: “Creating tools that others can use to reach new heights... that's how I reach them myself.”

Cosmetic_CollectableArtemis.name: Chthonic Chid, Artemis
Cosmetic_CollectableArtemis.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the goddess of the hunt.

Cosmetic_CollectableArtemis_Flavor.description: “The skilled huntress keeps her bag of tricks full and with her at all times.”

Cosmetic_CollectableEris.name: Chthonic Chid, Eris
Cosmetic_CollectableEris.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after Strife Incarnate.

Cosmetic_CollectableEris_Flavor.description: “It's not my fault I keep lying to you, manipulating you, shooting you with the Rail, making you clean up after me...”

Cosmetic_CollectableDora.name: Chthonic Chid, Dora
Cosmetic_CollectableDora.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the executor of the Renewal Project.

Cosmetic_CollectableDora_Flavor.description: “Nothing like a bunch of busywork to make you stop thinking about the pointlessness of your existence, right?”

Cosmetic_CollectableSelene.name: Chthonic Chid, Selene
Cosmetic_CollectableSelene.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after the Moon Incarnate.

Cosmetic_CollectableSelene_Flavor.description: “We breathe, we bleed, we rest, we start anew. Did we create this cycle, or are we merely part of it?”

Cosmetic_CollectableHypnos.name: Chthonic Chid, Hypnos
Cosmetic_CollectableHypnos.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Oddly proportioned collectable figure fashioned after Sleep Incarnate.

Cosmetic_CollectableHypnos_Flavor.description: “A good night's rest awaits! You just have to fight with everything you've got!”

Cosmetic_IcarusTable01.name: Workbench, Artisan's
Cosmetic_IcarusTable01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Well-equipped space for tinkering and so on, near to where {$Keywords.CharIcarus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_IcarusTable01_Flavor.description: While similar to an old bench once used by Daedalus himself, this one has its own touches and accessories.

Cosmetic_IcarusRug01.name: Rug, Minoan
Cosmetic_IcarusRug01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A traditional stretch of flooring fabric, near to where {$Keywords.CharIcarus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_IcarusRug01_Flavor.description: The preponderance of blue is said to be reminiscent of the sight of the sea.

Cosmetic_IcarusRug02.name: Rug, Sunburst
Cosmetic_IcarusRug02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: A bit of flooring in honor of daybreak, near to where {$Keywords.CharIcarus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_IcarusRug02_Flavor.description: There is some dispute as to whether the subject being honored here is the Titan Helios or the god Apollo.

Cosmetic_IcarusBombs01.name: Arsenal, Incendiary
Cosmetic_IcarusBombs01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Assortment of defused explosives, near to where {$Keywords.CharIcarus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_IcarusBombs01_Flavor.description: There was no appetite for storing live explosives in the Crossroads, but these are still exciting to an extent.

Cosmetic_IcarusMaps.name: Charts, Aether
Cosmetic_IcarusMaps.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticAdd}: Fairly up-to-date records of known airways, near to where {$Keywords.CharIcarus} typically resides.

Cosmetic_IcarusMaps_Flavor.description: Though few obstacles exist in the sky, navigating across it nonetheless can be fraught even for experienced flyers.

Cosmetic_CardDeck01.name: Arcana, Unseen
Cosmetic_CardDeck01.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Starter set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck01.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring the realms above and below.

Cosmetic_CardDeck01_Flavor.description: The experienced practitioner uses visual aids to distinguish between arrangements of Arcana for any given night.

Cosmetic_CardDeck02.name: Arcana, Nocturnal
Cosmetic_CardDeck02.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck02.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring each of the Fate-forged Nocturnal Arms.

Cosmetic_CardDeck02_Flavor.description: For the Silver Sisters, the Arcana and the Arms go hand in hand; it is natural to be predisposed to some of each.

Cosmetic_CardDeck03.name: Arcana, Close Aspect
Cosmetic_CardDeck03.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck03.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring an alternate Aspect for each of the Nocturnal Arms.

Cosmetic_CardDeck03_Flavor.description: Each bearer of the Nocturnal Arms is believed to have a close connection to at least one other, if not more.

Cosmetic_CardDeck04.name: Arcana, Distant Aspect
Cosmetic_CardDeck04.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck04.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring an ancient Aspect for each of the Nocturnal Arms.

Cosmetic_CardDeck04_Flavor.description: The bearers of the Arms have in common their dark origins and a charge to serve the realm beneath the Earth.

Cosmetic_CardDeck05.name: Arcana, Familiar
Cosmetic_CardDeck05.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck05.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring your very own {$Keywords.FamiliarPlural}.

Cosmetic_CardDeck05_Flavor.description: The essence of life, a timeless mystery even to the most devoted student of the Arcana; what binds all living beings?

Cosmetic_CardDeck06.name: Arcana, Fearsome
Cosmetic_CardDeck06.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck06.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, styled after the imposing {$Keywords.Shrine}.

Cosmetic_CardDeck06_Flavor.description: Those who swear the Vows come to have a healthy respect for Fear sooner or later, lest they be consumed by it.

Cosmetic_CardDeck07.name: Arcana, Hidden Aspect
Cosmetic_CardDeck07.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck07.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring a foreign Aspect for each of the Nocturnal Arms.

Cosmetic_CardDeck07_Flavor.description: Perhaps there are or shall be gods presiding over other, distant realms, each a visage of the Underworld we know.

Cosmetic_CardDeck08.name: Arcana, Fate-bound
Cosmetic_CardDeck08.description: {$Keywords.CosmeticDeck}: Set of {#UpgradeFormatDark}{$WorldUpgradeData.Cosmetic_CardDeck08.NumBackings} {#Prev}alternate themes, featuring symbols sacred to the Hades line.

Cosmetic_CardDeck08_Flavor.description: The Fates themselves chose Hades as god of the dead, binding him and his offspring forever beneath the Earth.

FamiliarCostume_FrogDefault.name: Familiar
FamiliarCostume_FrogDefault.description: {$Keywords.FamiliarCostume}: Standard appearance seen by most others.

GardenPlots.name: Soil Plots
GardenPlots.description: Bits of enchanted earth in which most type of seeds can quickly grow.

StoreItemPin.name: {!Icons.StoreItemPinNoTooltip} Forget-Me-Not
StoreItemPin.description: You are tracking this, and will see a special symbol with any resources required.

NeededPinResource.name: {!Icons.StoreItemPinNoTooltip} Needed Resource
NeededPinResource.description: You need this for one or more Forget-Me-Nots you are tracking.

NeededPinBoon_Codex.name: {!Icons.StoreItemPinNoTooltip} Tracked Boon
NeededPinBoon_Codex.description: You are tracking this, and will see a special symbol with any blessings it requires.

NeededPinBoon.name: {!Icons.StoreItemPinNoTooltip} Tracked Boon
NeededPinBoon.description: You need this for one or more Boons you are tracking.

CompletedPinResource.name: {!Icons.StoreItemPinCompleteNoTooltip} Tracked Resource
CompletedPinResource.description: You have enough of this for one or more Forget-Me-Nots you are tracking.

Card.name: Arcana Card
Card.description: A conduit of inner strength found in the {$Keywords.CardTable}.

CardPlural.name: Arcana
CardPlural.description: Conduits of inner strength found in the {$Keywords.CardTable}.

DeathBuff.name: {!Icons.Omega_NoTooltip} Combo
DeathBuff.description: Different {$Keywords.Omega} used in succession. Look for {!Icons.DeathIcon} as confirmation.

Familiar.name: Animal Familiar
Familiar.description: Loyal beast assistant-guardians under your protection. You may travel with {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev}at a time.

ShrineUpgradePlural.name: Vows
ShrineUpgradePlural.description: Invocations of various adverse nightly effects from the {#BoldFormatGraft}Oath of the Unseen{#Prev}.

MetaRank1_Icon.name: {!Icons.MetaRank1_NoTooltip} Arcana Card
MetaRank1_Icon.description: A conduit of inner strength from the {$Keywords.CardTable}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Power: {#Prev}{#BoldFormatGraft}Rank I{#Prev}

MetaRank2_Icon.name: {!Icons.MetaRank2_NoTooltip} Arcana Card
MetaRank2_Icon.description: A conduit of inner strength from the {$Keywords.CardTable}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Power: {#Prev}{#RareFormat}Rank II{#Prev}

MetaRank3_Icon.name: {!Icons.MetaRank3_NoTooltip} Arcana Card
MetaRank3_Icon.description: A conduit of inner strength from the {$Keywords.CardTable}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Power: {#Prev}{#EpicFormat}Rank III{#Prev}

MetaRank4_Icon.name: {!Icons.MetaRank4_NoTooltip} Arcana Card
MetaRank4_Icon.description: A conduit of inner strength from the {$Keywords.CardTable}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Power: {#Prev}{#HeroicFormat}Rank IV{#Prev}

AutoEquip.name: Awakening
AutoEquip.description: Cards that use {#GraspFormat}0{#Prev}{!Icons.ManaCrystal} and auto-activate, but only if their condition is met.

TalentPoint.name: Path of Stars
TalentPoint.description: Grants your choice of {$ConsumableData.TalentDrop.AddTalentPoints} or more linked upgrades for your {#BoldFormatGraft}{$Keywords.Spell} {#Prev}this night.

TalentPointMinor.description: Grants your choice of {$ConsumableData.MinorTalentDrop.AddTalentPoints} or more linked upgrades for your {#BoldFormatGraft}{$Keywords.Spell} {#Prev}this night.

TalentPointBig.description: Grants your choice of {$ConsumableData.TalentBigDrop.AddTalentPoints} or more linked upgrades for your {#BoldFormatGraft}{$Keywords.Spell} {#Prev}this night.

Warded.name: Warded
Warded.description: A magick-sealed gateway, impassable by all except the most experienced witches.

Weapon.name: Main Weapon
Weapon.description: The {#BoldFormatGraft}Nocturnal Arms{#Prev}, unique and ancient weapons created for the Silver Sisters.

Tool.name: Gathering Tool
Tool.description: Used to harvest resources from special deposits that appear from time to time.

Aspect.name: Aspect
Aspect.description: Alternate forms of the {#BoldFormatGraft}Nocturnal Arms{#Prev}, each with their own distinct style.

Broker.name: Wretched Broker
Broker.description: A Sales-Shade that once served the treasury of the House of Hades.

Statistican.name: Record Keeper
Statistican.description: A methodical Shade that once served in the House of Hades administrative chamber.

Historian.name: Learned Sage
Historian.description: A wizened Shade renowned for wisdom and knowledge in life and in death.

Bartender.name: Spirit Mixer
Bartender.description: A well-informed Shade that services the taverna and its many visitors.

MusicPlayer.name: Music Maker
MusicPlayer.description: A worldly Shade that plays beautiful melodies at listeners' behest.

ManaDropZeus.name: Aether Font
ManaDropZeus.description: Restores your {!Icons.Mana} when used, then expires, eventually reappearing in a random spot.

DrinkDrop.name: Grape Juice
DrinkDrop.description: Gives your very next move {#UpgradeFormat}+{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Damage} {#Prev}{$Keywords.BaseDamage}, then later reappears in a random spot.

Cloud.name: Festive Fog
Cloud.description: Emboldening vapors that repeatedly stun susceptible foes. Lasts {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.Duration} Sec.

ManaDropMinor.name: {!Icons.ManaItemIcon} Spirit Bubble
ManaDropMinor.description: A bit of magickal essence. Restores {#ManaFormat}{$ConsumableData.ManaDropMinor.AddMana}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana} when touched, then expires.

ManaItem_Hound.description: A bit of magickal essence. Restores {#ManaFormat}{$ConsumableData.ManaDropMinorHound.AddMana}{#Prev}{!Icons.Mana} when touched, then expires.

BloodDrop.name: Plasma
BloodDrop.description: Grants {#BoldFormatGraft}+{$ConsumableData.BloodDrop.SpeedBonusDisplay}% {#Prev}move and strike speed in this {$Keywords.RoomAlt} when touched, or soon expires.

BloodDropWithCount.name: Plasma
BloodDropWithCount.description: Grants faster move speed and strike speed in this {$Keywords.RoomAlt}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Currently: {#Prev}{#BoldFormatGraft}+{$CurrentRun.CurrentRoom.BloodDropBonus}%

RespawnEgg.name: Revenant
RespawnEgg.description: After {#BoldFormat}{$ObstacleData.RespawnEgg.SetupEvents.2.Args.Ticks} Sec.{#Prev}, this becomes the foe it came from, unless you collect it first.

ExtraMiniboss.name: Shadow Servant(s)
ExtraMiniboss.description: Dangerous apparitions reinforcing the {$Keywords.MiniBoss} you may be facing at the time.

GodBoon.name: Boon
GodBoon.description: Blessings from the Olympians, bestowing godlike power for this night.

Rarity.name: Rarity
Rarity.description: {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} sometimes have superior effects, noted as {#RareFormat}Rare{#Prev}, {#EpicFormat}Epic{#Prev}, and more.

PomPlural.name: Poms of Power
PomPlural.description: Underworld fruit that can enhance the effects of most {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}.

Common.name: Common
Common.description: Blessings from the gods are extraordinary by nature, but this is the garden variety.

CommonWithCount.description: Blessings from the gods are extraordinary, but some are less so. You have {#BoldFormatGraft}{$CurrentRun.Hero.GodBoonRarities.Common} {#Prev}now.

Epic.name: {#EpicFormat}Epic{#Prev}
Epic.description: Blessings imbued with significantly greater-than-usual power.

Legendary.name: {#LegendaryFormat}Legendary{#Prev}
Legendary.description: Blessings available only to those bearing a god's full favor.

Duo.name: {#DuoFormat}Duo{#Prev}
Duo.description: Blessings with the power of two different gods, offered to those favored by both.

Synergy.name: {#ElementalFormat}Infusion{#Prev}
Synergy.description: Blessings that grow in power the more {!Icons.EarthNoTooltip} {!Icons.WaterNoTooltip} {!Icons.AirNoTooltip} {!Icons.FireNoTooltip} {!Icons.AetherNoTooltip} you have.

AttackBoon.name: Attack Boon
AttackBoon.description: A blessing that strongly influences your {A2} {$Keywords.AttackSet}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Currently: {#Prev}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.SlotBoon}

SpecialBoon.name: Special Boon
SpecialBoon.description: A blessing that strongly influences your {A3} {$Keywords.SpecialSet}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Currently: {#Prev}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.SlotBoon}

SprintBoon.name: Rush Boon
SprintBoon.description: A blessing that strongly influences your \n {RU} {$Keywords.Dash}. {#ItalicLightFormat}Currently: {#Prev}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.SlotBoon}

SprintBoonAlt.name: Rush Boon
SprintBoonAlt.description: A blessing that strongly influences your \n {RU} {$Keywords.Dash} or {$Keywords.Sprint}.

HealthGate.name: Chaos Gate
HealthGate.description: A sacrifice of {!Icons.Health} is usually required to enter the unfathomable depths of {$Keywords.CharChaos}.

ChallengeSwitch.name: Infernal Trove
ChallengeSwitch.description: Treasure chests worth more the faster you slay the foes guarding them.

EliteChallengeSwitch.name: Moon Monument
EliteChallengeSwitch.description: Stones that grant magickal rewards if you vanquish the powerful foe haunting them.

PerfectClearChallengeSwitch.name: Unseen Sigil
PerfectClearChallengeSwitch.description: Monoliths that reward those who vanquish their foes without taking a scratch.

WellShop.name: Well of Charon
WellShop.description: Underworld stockpiles containing several useful items you can purchase using {!Icons.Currency}.

SurfaceShop.name: Shrine of Hermes
SurfaceShop.description: Surface monuments where you can special-order useful items using {!Icons.Currency}.

SellTraitShop.name: Pool of Purging
SellTraitShop.description: Infernal waters that may remove certain {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} for a surplus of {!Icons.Currency}.

Fountain.name: Fountain
Fountain.description: Drinking from these fixtures restores some {!Icons.Health} to the living.

ZoomOutObject.name: All-Seeing Bats
ZoomOutObject.description: Nocturnal creatures through which you can better see your surroundings.

RewardFinderObject.name: Golden Boughs
RewardFinderObject.description: Enchanted saplings that point the way to {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} and other points of interest nearby.

NewChamber.name: Hidden Pathway
NewChamber.description: A previously-inaccessible area becomes discoverable during your travels.

Room.name: Location(s)
Room.description: Various places comprising the {#BoldFormatGraft}Regions {#Prev}of the world beyond the Crossroads.

Encounter.name: Encounter(s)
Encounter.description: The dangerous kind; you must withstand your foes before you can proceed.

Biome.name: Region
Biome.description: A stretch of likely-dangerous {$Keywords.RoomPlural}, often with a {$Keywords.Boss} waiting at the end.

BiomePlural.name: Region(s)
BiomePlural.description: Stretches of likely-dangerous {$Keywords.RoomPlural}, often with a {$Keywords.Boss} waiting at the end.

BossPlural.name: Guardians
BossPlural.description: Exceptionally powerful foes that are the ultimate challenge in each {$Keywords.Biome}.

Boss.name: Guardian
Boss.description: An exceptionally powerful foe posing the ultimate challenge in any given {$Keywords.Biome}.

MiniBossPlural.name: Wardens
MiniBossPlural.description: Unique foes whose strength is rivaled only by the final {$Keywords.Boss} of each {$Keywords.Biome}.

UnusedWeaponBonus.name: {$TraitData.UnusedWeaponBonusTrait.Name}
UnusedWeaponBonus.description: Each night, a random {$Keywords.Weapon} can unearth {!Icons.MetaCurrencyIcon} from each {$Keywords.RoomAlt}.

FishingPoint.name: Fishing Point
FishingPoint.description: Places where you may attempt to use the {!Icons.ToolRodIcon} {$WeaponShopItemData.ToolFishingRod.Name} to retrieve something.

DiggingPoint.name: Digging Spot
DiggingPoint.description: Places where you may use the {!Icons.ToolShovelIcon} {$WeaponShopItemData.ToolShovel.Name} to retrieve something.

PickaxePoint.name: Outcropping
PickaxePoint.description: Places where you may use the {!Icons.ToolPickIcon} {$WeaponShopItemData.ToolPickaxe.Name} to retrieve something.

ExorcismPointPlural.name: Lost Shades
ExorcismPointPlural.description: Lingering spirits that grant {!Icons.MemPointsCommon_NoTooltip} when you pacify them with the {!Icons.ToolBookIcon} {$WeaponShopItemData.ToolExorcismBook.Name}.

HarvestPoint.name: Flora
HarvestPoint.description: Greenery and other valuable reagents that may be gathered up by hand.

RandomPom.name: {!Icons.RandomPom} Pom Slice
RandomPom.description: Raises the potency of {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev}random {$Keywords.GodBoon} you have at the time.

PomLevel.name: {!Icons.PomLevel_NoTooltip} Lv.
PomLevel.description: An increase to the raw power of one of your {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}, typically gained from {!Icons.Pom}.

Onion.name: {!Icons.Onion} Red Onion
Onion.description: Restores {#UpgradeFormat}1{#Prev}{!Icons.Health}. Tastes as bitter as you feel.

Hammer.name: {!Icons.Hammer} Daedalus Hammer
Hammer.description: Grants a special enchantment for your weapon for this night.

HammerPlural.name: {!Icons.Hammer} Daedalus Hammers
HammerPlural.description: Grant a special enchantment for your weapon for this night.

RunReward.name: Major Find
RunReward.description: Rewards that grant power, such as {#BoldFormatGraft}{$Keywords.GodBoonPlural}{#Prev}. Found in locations marked with {!Icons.RunReward}.

MetaReward.name: Minor Find
MetaReward.description: Rewards that grant resources, such as {!Icons.MetaCardPointsCommon} and {!Icons.MetaCurrency}. Found in locations marked with {!Icons.MetaReward}.

LimitedTimeOffer.name: {!Icons.LimitedTimeOfferBanner} Limited Quantities!
LimitedTimeOffer.description: The Wretched Broker has only {#BoldFormatGraft}1 {#Prev} of these in stock this night.

Keepsakes.name: Keepsakes
Keepsakes.description: Artifacts of power symbolizing the bond between two strong souls.

Crossroads.name: Crossroads
Crossroads.description: The {#BoldFormatGraft}Unseen {#Prev}reside in this liminal space between the Underworld and the surface.

RNG.name: Fate
RNG.description: A collection of seemingly random events preordained to occur each night.

BoostedLuck.name: Bonus Chance
BoostedLuck.description: This effect is {$SessionMapState.DisplayedLuckMultiplier:F} more likely to occur due to the influence of {$TraitData.LuckyBoon.Name}.

ExtraLivesWarning.name: {#AltPenaltyFormat}Inactive
ExtraLivesWarning.description: This cannot activate before you use up or remove {#ItalicFormat}all {#Prev}your {$Keywords.ExtraChanceAlt} effects.

TraitExchange.name: {!Icons.TraitExchange} Sacrifice
TraitExchange.description: This {$Keywords.GodBoon} has improved {$Keywords.Rarity}, but requires you to give up {$PurchaseTraitData.TraitToReplace}.

TraitExchangeAlt.name: Sacrifice Boons
TraitExchangeAlt.description: {$Keywords.GodBoonPlural} with improved {$Keywords.Rarity} that require you to give up another in their stead.

Invulnerable.name: Impervious
Invulnerable.description: A state in which you are completely invulnerable to damage.

InvulnerableAlt.name: Doomed
InvulnerableAlt.description: You are {$Keywords.Invulnerable} but have just {#BoldFormatGraft}{$TooltipData.ExtractData.TooltipLastStandTimer} Sec. {#Prev}to vanquish your remaining foes, {#ItalicFormat}or else...

Deflect.name: Deflect
Deflect.description: Send foes' strikes and projectiles right back at them without taking a scratch.

Crit.name: Critical
Crit.description: A devastating blow that deals {#BoldFormatGraft}+{$ConstantsData.ReportedCriticalMultiplier}% {#Prev}damage or greater.

Armor.name: Armor
Armor.description: Elite foes cannot be stunned or knocked away until you break their golden barriers.

PlayerArmor.name: {!Icons.ArmorTotal} Armor
PlayerArmor.description: Any damage you sustain reduces your {#BoldFormatGraft}Armor {#Prev}before reducing your {#BoldFormatGraft}Life{#Prev}.

ShieldHealth.name: {!Icons.ShieldHealth} Barrier
ShieldHealth.description: Negates the next instance of damage, even if it would have been an awful lot.

BaseDamage.name: Power
BaseDamage.description: An increase to the base amount of damage you inflict. Other bonuses multiply by this.

AttackSet.name: Attacks
AttackSet.description: Press {A2} for your weapon's main attack, or hold {A2} to use {!Icons.Mana} for a stronger effect.

Attack.name: Attack
Attack.description: Press {A2} for your weapon's main attack.

AttackEX.name: {!Icons.Omega_NoTooltip} Attack
AttackEX.description: Hold {A2} to use {!Icons.Mana} for your weapon's magick-imbued attack.

SpecialSet.name: Specials
SpecialSet.description: Press {A3} for your weapon's special move, or hold {A3} to use {!Icons.Mana} for a stronger effect.

Special.name: Special
Special.description: Press {A3} for your weapon's special move.

SpecialEX.name: {!Icons.Omega_NoTooltip} Special
SpecialEX.description: Hold {A3} to use {!Icons.Mana} for your weapon's magick-imbued special move.

DashSet.name: Rushing
DashSet.description: Press {RU} to quickly lunge forward, avoiding damage; hold to keep running at top speed.

Dash.name: Dash
Dash.description: Press {RU} to quickly lunge forward, avoiding any damage.

Sprint.name: Sprint
Sprint.description: Hold {RU} to Dash then keep running at top speed.

CastSet.name: Casts
CastSet.description: Press {A1} for a binding spell, or hold {A1} to use {!Icons.Mana} for the damaging {!Icons.Omega} version.

Cast.name: Cast
Cast.description: Press {A1} for a binding spell that ensnares foes and can gain other properties.

CastEX.name: {!Icons.Omega_NoTooltip} Cast
CastEX.description: Hold {A1} to use {!Icons.Mana} for a binding spell that damages foes when it expires.

Spell.name: Hex
Spell.description: After using enough {!Icons.Mana} while foes are near, press {SH} to invoke the Moon's might.

FirstTimeSpell.name: Godsent
FirstTimeSpell.description: Whenever you first use your {$Keywords.Spell} in a {$Keywords.RoomAlt}, it provides an Olympian's aid.

FirstTimeSpell2.name: {!Icons.OlympianSpell} Olympus Rising
FirstTimeSpell2.description: The {$Keywords.TalentPoint} for this {$Keywords.Spell} will include a {$Keywords.FirstTimeSpell} effect from an Olympian.

WeaponSet.name: Weapon
WeaponSet.description: Press or hold {A2} or {A3} to use your main weapon in a variety of ways.

GodMode.name: God Mode
GodMode.description: A state in which you are even tougher; after you die, you grow a little tougher still.

GodModeTrait.name: Deus Ex Machina
GodModeTrait.description: You are resistant to all sources of damage while in {$Keywords.GodMode}.

PowerShot.name: Power Shot
PowerShot.description: Hold {A2} then release when you see a brief flash for a stronger shot.

PowerShotSpecial.name: Power Shot
PowerShotSpecial.description: Hold {A3} then release when you see a brief flash for a stronger shot.

DashStrike.name: Dash-Strike
DashStrike.description: Press {RU} to Dash then immediately press {A2} for a unique attack.

Dodge.name: Dodge
Dodge.description: Automatically avoid an instance of damage you would have otherwise taken.

Traps.name: Traps
Traps.description: Inanimate objects that harm whatever gets in their way.

Status.name: Curse
Status.description: A lingering effect that makes things worse for your foes for some time.

StatusPlural.name: Curses
StatusPlural.description: Lingering effects that make things worse for your foes for some time.

StatusPluralAlt.description: Effects that make things worse for your foes. Look for {!Icons.VulnerabilityIcon} for the bonus damage.

Perks.name: Perk(s)
Perks.description: A variety of traits and special abilities that make foes even more dangerous.

QuestItem.name: {!Icons.FatedChoice} Fated Choice
QuestItem.description: One of the {#BoldFormatGraft}Prophecies {#Prev}on the {#BoldFormatGraft}Fated List {#Prev}indicates you will choose this.

ExtendedShopBefore.name: {!Icons.ExtendedShop_NoTooltip} Long-Lasting
ExtendedShopBefore.description: Purchasing this next will use your {$TraitData.ExtendedShopTrait.Name} to significantly extend its duration.

ExtendedShopAfter.name: {!Icons.ExtendedShop_NoTooltip} Long-Lasting
ExtendedShopAfter.description: This item's duration is significantly extended due to {$TraitData.ExtendedShopTrait.Name}.

NoTalentBonus.name: {!Icons.Moon_Crescent} Crescent Moonglow
NoTalentBonus.description: This {$Keywords.Spell} has no special bonuses; the sheer might of the Moon shall have to suffice.

MidTalentBonus.name: {!Icons.Moon_Half} Half Moonglow
MidTalentBonus.description: This {$Keywords.Spell} has greater potential; it gains {#RareFormat}+{$TempTextData.BonusPoints} {#Prev}upgrade from your next {$Keywords.TalentPoint}.

HiTalentBonus.name: {!Icons.Moon_Full} Full Moonglow
HiTalentBonus.description: This {$Keywords.Spell} has the most potential; it gains {#EpicFormat}+{$TempTextData.BonusPoints} {#Prev}upgrades from your next {$Keywords.TalentPoint}.

HadesSpearPoints.name: Gigaros
HadesSpearPoints.description: Mostly used by {$Keywords.CharHades} himself to intimidate if not skewer his foes.

WorldUpgradeWakeHypnosT3.name: End to Dumbest Slumber
WorldUpgradeWakeHypnosT3.description: Plunge to the speechless depths of the psyche of {$Keywords.CharHypnos} to try and rouse him, again. Grants {#UpgradeFormatDark}+1{#Prev}{!Icons.HypnosPointsIcon}.

WorldUpgradeWakeHypnosT3_Flavor.description: One with both the power and desire to sleep forever may yet regain consciousness willingly, or not at all.
